Despite the ill-conditioning, predictions remain controlled when the training targets are exact. Finite sampling produces a systematic prediction error that decreases quadratically with $N$, while fluctuations induced by the random training measurements decrease inversely with the total training budget. Thus, unlike in standard linear regression with exactly known features, increasing the dataset size alone cannot remove the error caused by sampling noise. If the training targets are also noisy, due for instance to state-preparation errors, the otherwise hidden directions become active. The test error can then increase with $N$, a behavior that we ascribe to a form of quantum overfitting. Our results expose a fundamental tradeoff between dataset size and per-state statistics in non-variational quantum learning and provide a baseline for resource-aware training and regularization strategies.
papers.title_cn: 谁能永远采样？量子线性回归中的散粒噪声效应
papers.abs_cn: 量子保真度核与量子极限学习机共享相同的基本架构：一个固定的量子设备生成特征，这些特征通过一个经典训练的线性模型进行组合。我们将这一广泛的非变分设置称为量子线性回归。这些模型的一个决定性特征是，量子特征并非直接可得，而必须从有限次测量中估计。我们表明，有限统计量使得量子线性回归不可避免地病态。理想特征向量被限制在由希尔伯特空间维度决定的子空间内，而有限次测量的估计通常会获得该子空间之外的成分。训练随后试图拟合在无限统计极限下消失的方向，使得学习到的模型对采样噪声越来越敏感。我们针对在 $n_{m tr}$ 个态上训练、每个态使用 $N$ 次测量的量子极限学习机分析了这一机制。尽管存在病态性，当训练目标精确时，预测仍然可控。有限采样产生一个系统性预测误差，该误差随 $N$ 二次递减，而由随机训练测量引起的波动则随总训练预算反比递减。因此，与特征精确已知的标准线性回归不同，仅增加数据集大小无法消除由采样噪声引起的误差。如果训练目标也有噪声，例如由于态制备误差，那么原本隐藏的方向会变得活跃。测试误差随后可能随 $N$ 增大，我们将这种行为归因于一种量子过拟合。我们的结果揭示了非变分量子学习中数据集大小与每态统计量之间的基本权衡，并为资源感知的训练和正则化策略提供了基线。

papers.title: Exact value and rigidity of the $2\times3$ magic rectangle
papers.abstract: The $2\times3$ magic rectangle is a nonlocal game in which two players match entries subject to incompatible parity constraints. We prove that its quantum value is $(1+\sqrt{2/3})/2$ and classify all optimal strategies in arbitrary finite local dimensions, allowing general measurements. Every optimal strategy contains a maximally entangled pair of four-dimensional systems, with fixed measurements on the local state supports up to local isometries and ancillary systems. The attaining construction was previously known from quantum random access codes. An exact sum-of-squares identity gives the upper bound, and its equality relations determine the measurement algebra needed for the classification. The rectangle determines the largest magic-square score compatible with perfect prediction of Alice's first row by an adversary with quantum side information. We classify all finite-dimensional strategies attaining this score with perfect prediction and show that one minus the best compatible guessing probability has linear order in the score excess above it. The same rigidity theorem classifies all optimal three-bit random access codes that hide the full input parity.
papers.title_cn: $2\times3$ 魔幻矩形的精确值与刚性
papers.abs_cn: 2×3 魔幻矩形是一种非局域博弈，其中两名玩家在不相容的奇偶约束下匹配条目。我们证明其量子值为 (1+sqrt(2/3))/2，并对任意有限局域维度下允许一般测量的所有最优策略进行了分类。每个最优策略都包含一对最大纠缠的四维系统，其局域态支撑上的测量在局域等距和辅助系统意义下是固定的。达到该值的构造此前已从量子随机存取码中得知。一个精确的平方和恒等式给出了上界，其等号关系确定了分类所需的测量代数。该矩形确定了与对手在量子边信息下完美预测 Alice 第一行相容的最大魔方得分。我们对所有达到该得分且具有完美预测的有限维策略进行了分类，并证明 1 减去最佳相容猜测概率与得分超出量呈线性阶。同一定理还分类了所有隐藏完整输入奇偶性的最优三比特随机存取码。

papers.title: On the separability of Bell-diagonal states with absolutely positive partial transposition
papers.abstract: Absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT) states, which remain PPT under every global unitary, provide a spectral relaxation of absolutely separable states, which remain separable under every such transformation. Despite substantial progress, whether these two notions coincide beyond qubit-qudit systems remains unresolved, motivating the study of structured state families in which the APPT spectral constraints and separability can be analyzed exactly. We study this problem for Bell-diagonal states in two settings: the standard two-qutrit Weyl-Heisenberg basis and the two-ququart lattice basis generated by two-qubit Pauli operators. In the two-qutrit case, we show that a linearized necessary condition for APPT defines a polytope of spectra in which every associated Weyl-Heisenberg Bell-diagonal state admits an exact decomposition into explicitly separable states. This yields a separability criterion that applies to a region even larger than the APPT set itself. In the two-ququart lattice Bell-diagonal setting, we show that a state remains PPT under every permutation of its Bell coefficients if and only if its six largest Bell coefficients sum to at most 1/2, and we prove that all such states are separable. Equivalently, every entangled lattice Bell-diagonal state becomes NPT after a suitable coefficient permutation and is therefore not APPT. The proofs combine convex-polytope analysis, affine and symplectic orbit reductions, and exact rational decompositions into separable states supported on affine Lagrangian subsets. Our results rule out entangled APPT states in both Bell-diagonal families, and provide simple spectral inequalities as sufficient criteria for separability in both cases. Being basis-specific, however, they do not by themselves settle whether APPT and absolute separability coincide.
papers.title_cn: 论具有绝对正偏转置的贝尔对角态的可分性
papers.abs_cn: 绝对正偏转置（APPT）态是指在任意全局酉变换下都保持PPT的态，它提供了绝对可分态（在任意此类变换下都保持可分）的谱松弛。尽管已取得重大进展，这两个概念在超越量子比特-量子迪特系统之外是否一致仍未解决，这促使我们研究结构化的态族，以便精确分析APPT谱约束与可分性。我们在两种设定下研究贝尔对角态的这一问题：标准双量子三特Weyl-Heisenberg基，以及由双量子比特Pauli算子生成的双量子四特格点基。在双量子三特情形中，我们证明APPT的一个线性化必要条件定义了一个谱多胞体，其中每个相关联的Weyl-Heisenberg贝尔对角态都允许精确分解为显式可分态。这给出了一个可分性判据，其适用范围甚至大于APPT集本身。在双量子四特格点贝尔对角设定中，我们证明一个态在其贝尔系数的任意置换下都保持PPT，当且仅当其六个最大贝尔系数之和至多为1/2，并且我们证明所有此类态都是可分的。等价地，每个纠缠的格点贝尔对角态在适当的系数置换后都变为NPT，因此不是APPT。证明结合了凸多胞体分析、仿射与辛轨道约化，以及支撑在仿射拉格朗日子集上的可分态的精确有理分解。我们的结果排除了这两个贝尔对角族中的纠缠APPT态，并在两种情形下提供了简单的谱不等式作为可分性的充分判据。然而，由于这些结果依赖于特定基，它们本身并不能解决APPT与绝对可分性是否一致的问题。

papers.title: Unitary-accessible coherence-erasure distance: Exact qubit solution and a tight qutrit bound
papers.abstract: We introduce the unitary-accessible coherence-erasure distance, which measures the minimum unitary-control cost required to transform a quantum state into an incoherent state without changing its spectrum. The target states are restricted to incoherent states on the same unitary orbit, leading to a geometry different from conventional state-space proximity. We establish inequalities relating orbit-restricted quantum transport, Bures geometry, and the unitary-control distance. These quantities coincide for pure states but can differ for mixed states. For qubits, we derive an exact expression and show that, in the nondegenerate case, the coherence-erasure cost depends on the eigenbasis orientation rather than on the eigenvalues. For nondegenerate qutrits, we reduce the problem to an optimization over the monomial unitary group. We derive the tight universal bound $\arccos[(2\sqrt2-1)/4]$ and construct an explicit eigenbasis that attains it. The resulting distance also determines the minimum coherence-erasure time under bounded unitary driving, giving it a direct operational meaning.
papers.title_cn: 酉可达相干擦除距离：精确的量子比特解与紧致的量子三态界
papers.abs_cn: 我们引入了酉可达相干擦除距离，它衡量将一个量子态在不改变其谱的情况下转变为非相干态所需的最小酉控制代价。目标态被限制在同一酉轨道上的非相干态，导致其几何结构不同于传统状态空间邻近性。我们建立了轨道限制量子输运、Bures 几何与酉控制距离之间的不等式关系。这些量在纯态下重合，但在混合态下可能不同。对于量子比特，我们推导出精确表达式，并证明在非简并情况下，相干擦除代价取决于本征基的取向而非本征值。对于非简并量子三态，我们将问题归结为在单项式酉群上的优化。我们推导出紧致的普适界 $\arccos[(2\sqrt2-1)/4]$，并构造了一个达到该界的显式本征基。所得距离还确定了有界酉驱动下的最小相干擦除时间，赋予其直接的操作意义。

papers.title: Multifunctional synaptic learning and neuromorphic computing using crystalline TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$ heterojunction-based memory devices
papers.abstract: An attempt is made here to mimic different properties of biological synapses using Ag/TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$/p$^{++}$-Si memristor structure by studying its different transport properties under dc and pulsed bias. The presence of crystalline NiO$_x$ with smaller gains is found to be helpful to get TiO$_x$ deposited on its top with crystalline properties and larger grains. The heterostructure offers stable bipolar forming free non-volatile resistive switching characteristics under reverse biased condition with gradual set and reset features. These devices are also able to successfully implement the classical Pavlov's learning, study artificial nociceptor and Morse code detection. While incorporating synaptic weights derived from the measured conductance programming pulse relationship, an artificial neural network achieves nearly 95\% accuracy in MNIST digit recognition. In brief, NiO$_x$/TiO$_x$ heterojunction plays the pivotal role in getting such reproducible $I-V$ characteristics for mimicking different properties of biological synapses.
papers.title_cn: 利用晶态 TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$ 异质结基存储器件实现多功能突触学习与神经形态计算
papers.abs_cn: 本文尝试利用 Ag/TiO$_x$/NiO$_x$/p$^{++}$-Si 忆阻器结构，通过研究其在直流和脉冲偏压下的不同输运特性，来模拟生物突触的多种功能。研究发现，具有较小增益的晶态 NiO$_x$ 有助于在其顶部沉积出具有晶态特性和较大晶粒的 TiO$_x$。该异质结构在反向偏置条件下呈现出稳定的双极无形成电压的非易失阻变特性，并具有渐变 set 和 reset 特征。这些器件还能成功实现经典的巴甫洛夫学习、人工伤害感受器研究以及摩尔斯电码检测。在将基于所测电导编程脉冲关系得到的突触权重纳入人工神经网络后，该网络在 MNIST 手写数字识别中达到了近 95% 的准确率。简言之，NiO$_x$/TiO$_x$ 异质结在获得这种可重复的 $I-V$ 特性以模拟生物突触的不同功能方面发挥了关键作用。

papers.title: Magnon dynamics driven by the symplectic quantum metric in a chiral soliton lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the effects of quantum geometry on the motion of magnon wave packets in one-dimensional quantum spin chains. In contrast to fermionic systems, where transport phenomena driven by the quantum metric have been extensively studied, we show that the dynamics in bosonic magnon systems are strongly affected by the symplectic structure and the pseudo-unitarity of the transformation of the magnon Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian. A chiral soliton lattice provides a setting in which the symplectic quantum metric strongly influences the longitudinal magnon dynamics. We derive the semiclassical response of a magnon wave packet in such a system to a weak, slowly varying perturbation and demonstrate that the wave packet velocity acquires a geometric contribution proportional to the momentum derivative of the symplectic quantum metric, which dominates over the conventional group velocity for a nearly flat band. Solving the resulting equations of motion, we obtain a bounded trajectory in real time with a phase-space area determined by the symplectic quantum metric.
papers.title_cn: 手性孤子晶格中由辛量子度规驱动的磁振子动力学
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究量子几何对一维量子自旋链中磁振子波包运动的影响。与费米子系统（其中由量子度规驱动的输运现象已被广泛研究）不同，我们表明玻色型磁振子系统中的动力学受到辛结构以及磁振子 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 哈密顿量变换的伪幺正性的强烈影响。手性孤子晶格提供了一种设置，其中辛量子度规强烈影响纵向磁振子动力学。我们推导了此类系统中磁振子波包对弱且缓慢变化的微扰的半经典响应，并证明波包速度获得了一个几何贡献，该贡献正比于辛量子度规对动量的导数，并且在近平坦能带中主导了传统的群速度。求解所得的运动方程，我们得到了实时间中的有界轨迹，其相空间面积由辛量子度规决定。

papers.title: Homogeneous Charge Relaxation in Organic Mixed Ionic-Electronic Conductors
papers.abstract: Organic mixed ionic-electronic conductors (OMIECs) couple ionic and electronic signals, enabling energy storage, neuromorphic computing, and bioelectronics. However, how charge relaxes in water once the bias is removed, which determines how long stored states persist, remains unclear. Using operando charge photometry, we tracked charge in OMIEC films during biasing and open-circuit relaxation. Under bias, charges moved as redox fronts. After bias removal, charge instead relaxed uniformly across the channel. Modeling and cryo-electron microscopy indicate that swelling creates connected water-rich pathways through the bulk. These pathways speed ion motion but also let stored charge leak away. Tuning the terminal side chain of a polythiophene controls water uptake and ion trapping. Bulky hydrophobic side chains enable stable programmable states, whereas hydrophilic side chains support fast electrophysiology sensing.
papers.title_cn: 有机混合离子-电子导体中的均匀电荷弛豫
papers.abs_cn: 有机混合离子-电子导体（OMIECs）耦合离子和电子信号，可实现能量存储、神经形态计算和生物电子学。然而，一旦去除偏压，电荷在水中如何弛豫——这决定了存储状态能持续多久——仍不清楚。利用操作电荷光度法，我们追踪了OMIEC薄膜在偏压和开路弛豫过程中的电荷。在偏压下，电荷以氧化还原前沿的形式移动。去除偏压后，电荷反而在通道中均匀弛豫。建模和冷冻电子显微镜表明，溶胀在体相中形成了连通的富水通路。这些通路加速了离子运动，但也让存储的电荷泄漏出去。调节聚噻吩的末端侧链可控制吸水性和离子捕获。庞大的疏水侧链可实现稳定的可编程状态，而亲水侧链则支持快速电生理传感。

papers.title: Mutual Linearity of Complexes in Chemical Reaction Networks
papers.abstract: Exact statements about how a system far from equilibrium responds to changes in its rate constants are scarce beyond linear response, yet they are central to the control of biochemical networks. A notable exception is mutual linearity: in a jump process, controlling the rates of a single transition makes any two stationary probabilities obey an exact affine relation, arbitrarily far from equilibrium. With nonlinear mass-action kinetics, and conservation laws in place of a normalization, chemical reaction networks seem to defy mutual linearity since species concentrations obey no such relation. We show that it was there all along, in the complexes' activities (mass-action monomials) rather than in the concentrations of species. For zero-deficiency networks with a single linkage class, controlling one reaction makes any three stationary activities obey a linear relation whose coefficients are independent of the controlled rate constants, the conserved quantities (hence the initial state), and even of the stoichiometry of complexes. This predicts hidden activities and bounds the activity ratios the control can reach, while a violation signals nonzero deficiency or multiple linkage classes.
papers.title_cn: 化学反应网络中复合物的相互线性
papers.abs_cn: 关于远离平衡态的系统如何响应速率常数变化的精确陈述，在线性响应之外极为稀少，但它们对生化网络的控制至关重要。一个显著的例外是相互线性：在跳跃过程中，控制单个跃迁的速率会使任意两个稳态概率服从精确的仿射关系，且任意远离平衡态。对于非线性质量作用动力学，以及以守恒律代替归一化，化学反应网络似乎违背了相互线性，因为物种浓度不服从这种关系。我们表明，它一直存在，存在于复合物的活性（质量作用单项式）中，而非物种的浓度中。对于具有单个连接类的零亏格网络，控制一个反应会使任意三个稳态活性服从线性关系，其系数独立于被控制的速率常数、守恒量（因而独立于初始状态），甚至独立于复合物的化学计量。这预测了隐藏活性，并界定了控制所能达到的活性比，而违反则表明非零亏格或多个连接类。

papers.title: Reassessing the $X(2370)$ in $J/ψ\toγK_S^0K_S^0π^0$ beyond the one-dimensional mass projections
papers.abstract: The BESIII Collaboration recently extracted the properties of the $X(2370)$ from a fit to the one-dimensional $K_S^0K_S^0π^0$ invariant-mass spectrum in $J/ψ\toγK_S^0K_S^0π^0$. The intermediate two-body structures visible in the mass correlations, including the $K_0^*(1430)$ bands, require a coherent treatment of cross-channel interference when interpreting the enhancement near 2.3 GeV. We reassess the need for an additional $X(2370)$ contribution by fitting the published data using an effective coupled-channel framework. The three-body parent amplitude is parameterized by a $K$-matrix as the scattering among several quasi-two-body channels. The seven- and eight-bare-state models give similar mass distributions. Adding the eighth bare state lowers the Poisson deviance by 1.26% and produces an additional pole at $E=(2424-i\,149)$ MeV, substantially broader than the $X(2370)$ mass-width reference. This pole is model-dependent, and its identification with the $X(2370)$ is not clear. The present analysis does not establish the need for an additional $X(2370)$ contribution in $J/ψ\toγK_S^0K_S^0π^0$, thereby weakening the flavor-singlet argument based on the suppression of $K^*\bar K$ relative to the total $K\bar Kπ$ contribution. A more comprehensive experimental amplitude analysis, incorporating coherent interference, mass and angular correlations, and detector effects across related decay channels, is needed to establish the role and decay properties of the $X(2370)$.
papers.title_cn: 在 J/ψ→γK_S^0K_S^0π^0 中超越一维质量投影重新评估 X(2370)
papers.abs_cn: BESIII 合作组最近通过拟合 J/ψ→γK_S^0K_S^0π^0 中一维 K_S^0K_S^0π^0 不变质量谱提取了 X(2370) 的性质。质量关联中可见的中间两体结构，包括 K_0^*(1430) 带，要求在解释 2.3 GeV 附近的增强时对交叉道干涉进行相干处理。我们通过使用有效耦合道框架拟合已发表数据，重新评估了额外 X(2370) 贡献的必要性。三体母振幅通过 K-矩阵参数化为若干准两体道之间的散射。七裸态和八裸态模型给出相似的质量分布。加入第八个裸态使泊松偏差降低 1.26%，并产生一个位于 E=(2424-i 149) MeV 的额外极点，其宽度远大于 X(2370) 的质量-宽度参考值。该极点依赖于模型，其与 X(2370) 的对应关系并不明确。当前分析并未确立 J/ψ→γK_S^0K_S^0π^0 中需要额外 X(2370) 贡献，从而削弱了基于 K^* ar K 相对于总 K ar Kπ 贡献 suppressed 的味单态论证。需要更全面的实验振幅分析，纳入相干干涉、质量和角关联以及相关衰变道中的探测器效应，以确立 X(2370) 的作用和衰变性质。

papers.title: A Gauge-Invariant Clustering Coefficient for Complex-Weighted Bipartite Networks
papers.abstract: Structural measures such as the clustering coefficient and the average shortest-path length characterise how a network is organised. These measures are typically formulated for real, non-negative edge weights. A class of quantum and photonic architectures has complex edge weights instead, whose phases determine whether alternative routes interfere constructively or destructively. These architectures are also bipartite, so triangles are absent and the smallest closed cycle is a four-node square. Existing measures address complex weights and bipartite structure separately: bipartite clustering coefficients quantify clustering through four-node squares but do not contain phase information, while interferometric coefficients retain phase but are defined on triangles. In this work, we define a clustering coefficient for complex-weighted bipartite networks which reduces to the classical bipartite coefficient when the phases vanish, becomes negative when alternative routes cancel, and can be obtained for all nodes from a single sparse matrix product. We show that the phase accumulated around a square is the smallest gauge-invariant carrier of structural phase information in a bipartite network. The clustering coefficient factorises into a topological contribution and a phase contribution, making a bipartite Watts--Strogatz ensemble analytically tractable. For phases uniformly distributed on $[-Δ,Δ]$, the mean phase contribution is $(\sinΔ/Δ)^4$, independent of node, degree, and topology. We also derive closed-form expressions for the clustering coefficient, open-path visibility, and phase variance. We numerically verify these predictions and further show that phase disorder increases coherent distance.
papers.title_cn: 复权重二分网络的规范不变聚类系数
papers.abs_cn: 聚类系数和平均最短路径长度等结构度量刻画了网络的组织方式。这些度量通常针对实数、非负的边权重而制定。一类量子和光子架构则具有复数边权重，其相位决定了替代路径是相长干涉还是相消干涉。这些架构也是二分的，因此不存在三角形，最小的闭合环是四节点方形。现有度量分别处理复权重和二分结构：二分聚类系数通过四节点方形量化聚类，但不包含相位信息；而干涉系数保留相位，却定义在三角形上。在本工作中，我们为复权重二分网络定义了一个聚类系数，当相位消失时它退化为经典二分系数，当替代路径相消时它变为负值，并且可以通过单次稀疏矩阵乘积获得所有节点的值。我们证明，围绕一个方形累积的相位是二分网络中结构相位信息的最小规范不变载体。该聚类系数分解为拓扑贡献和相位贡献，使得二分 Watts--Strogatz 系综在解析上易于处理。对于均匀分布在 $[-Δ,Δ]$ 上的相位，平均相位贡献为 $(sinΔ/Δ)^4$，与节点、度和拓扑无关。我们还推导了聚类系数、开放路径可见度和相位方差的闭式表达式。我们通过数值验证了这些预测，并进一步表明相位无序会增加相干距离。

papers.title: Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT
papers.abstract: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.
papers.title_cn: AdS/BCFT 中的多体纠缠几何
papers.abs_cn: 多体纠缠度量探测的是量子关联在超出两两熵所能推断范围之外的组织方式。我们研究在全息 BCFT 中，这种结构如何被物理边界重塑。端世界膜为多体纠缠打开了新的相对同调通道，使得连通的体区域网络能够在不必与任何普通 Ryu--Takayanagi 转变重合的尺度上重组和因子化。在静态 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 中，这产生了多体相的特征性层级，以及真正多体熵对边界的非平凡依赖。在热场双态中，真正连通的网络反而可以通过 Einstein--Rosen 桥得到支持，导致其增长、重连和饱和尺度不同于通常的 Hartman--Maldacena 转变。这些结果表明，多体纠缠不仅对极值曲面面积敏感，也对体纠缠结构在存在边界时被允许如何连接、分裂和终止的方式敏感。

papers.title: Comprehensive study of massively overlapping cascades in common elemental metals
papers.abstract: Massively overlapping cascades simulations were carried out in 21 elemental metals: Be, Al, Ti, V, Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zr, Nb, Mo, Rh, Pd, Ag, Hf, Ta, W, Pt, Au and Pb. These elements have simple FCC, BCC and HCP lattice structures. For each element, 2000 cumulative 5 keV cascades were simulated using molecular dynamics. The overlapping cascades were simulated using various classical analytical interatomic potentials as well as with machine-learning interatomic potentials for many of the elements. The general conclusion is that results from massively overlapping cascades simulations are very sensitive to the choice of interatomic potential across the periodic table. Furthermore, we see that FCC metals all form stacking fault tetrahedra due to irradiation, and also typically include interstitial type Shockley partial and Frank type dislocations. In BCC materials typically form interstitial 1/2$\langle$1 1 1$\rangle$ dislocations, but vacancy type 1/2$\langle$1 1 1$\rangle$ dislocations were also observed in V and Nb. HCP materials tend to form complex dislocation structures mainly consisting of a-type dislocations that can be of both vacancy or interstitial type. Correlations between saturated defect concentrations and fundamental underlying material properties are explored.
papers.title_cn: 常见元素金属中大规模重叠级联的综合研究
papers.abs_cn: 在21种元素金属中进行了大规模重叠级联模拟：Be、Al、Ti、V、Cr、Fe、Co、Ni、Cu、Zr、Nb、Mo、Rh、Pd、Ag、Hf、Ta、W、Pt、Au和Pb。这些元素具有简单的FCC、BCC和HCP晶格结构。对于每种元素，使用分子动力学模拟了2000个累积5 keV级联。对于许多元素，使用各种经典分析型原子间势以及机器学习原子间势来模拟重叠级联。总体结论是，在元素周期表中，大规模重叠级联模拟的结果对原子间势的选择非常敏感。此外，我们看到FCC金属由于辐照都形成堆垛层错四面体，并且通常还包括间隙型Shockley分位错和Frank型位错。在BCC材料中通常形成间隙型1/2<1 1 1>位错，但在V和Nb中也观察到空位型1/2<1 1 1>位错。HCP材料倾向于形成复杂的位错结构，主要由a型位错组成，这些位错可以是空位型或间隙型。探讨了饱和缺陷浓度与基本材料性能之间的相关性。

papers.title: The Fiedler dimension of networks of networks: from fractal to small-world architectures
papers.abstract: Is the relaxation of a modular network dictated by its modules or by the network that connects them? The answer fixes the time scales of diffusion, consensus, and synchronization, all set by the Fiedler eigenvalue. We show that, for bundled networks, the two levels act one after the other: a random walker must first escape from its module and then spread over the network that connects them. The equilibration time is the sum of these two times, the time needed to reach the base from inside a fiber and the relaxation time of the base, slowed down by the mass of the fibers. The consequences are unexpected. However large the modules are, a small-world core always imposes its own Fiedler dimension; the modules survive only as a logarithmic correction, which slows down equilibration and hides the true exponent up to sizes far beyond any real network. Effective dimensions measured on finite modular systems can therefore be systematically biased. We analytically work out all combinations of finite-dimensional and small-world bases and fibers, and compare them with numerically exact spectra of representatives of each category.
papers.title_cn: 网络之网络的 Fiedler 维度：从分形到小世界架构
papers.abs_cn: 一个模块化网络的弛豫是由其模块决定，还是由连接它们的网络决定？这个问题的答案决定了扩散、共识和同步的时间尺度，而所有这些都由 Fiedler 特征值设定。我们表明，对于捆绑网络，这两个层次依次起作用：随机游走者必须首先逃离其所在模块，然后扩散到连接这些模块的网络上。平衡时间是这两个时间之和，即从纤维内部到达基底所需的时间，以及基底的弛豫时间，后者因纤维的质量而减慢。其后果出人意料。无论模块多大，小世界核心总是强加其自身的 Fiedler 维度；模块仅作为对数修正而存留，这减慢了平衡过程，并在远超任何真实网络的尺度上隐藏了真实指数。因此，在有限模块化系统上测得的有效维度可能会系统性地产生偏差。我们解析地推导了有限维和小世界基底与纤维的所有组合，并将它们与各类别代表网络的数值精确谱进行了比较。

papers.title: Emergent SSH physics and localization in a cavity--atom system beyond the rotating-wave approximation
papers.abstract: We investigate a cavity--atom system beyond the rotating-wave approximation and recast its dynamics as an effective tight-binding problem in the excitation-number basis. The same experimentally relevant light--matter platform exhibits two distinct regimes controlled by the photon number. In the large-photon-number regime, the hopping amplitudes become nearly uniform and the effective lattice reduces to a dimerized SSH-type chain subject to a linear energy gradient. The spectrum then organizes into one or two Wannier--Stark ladders, giving rise to controllable Bloch and Bloch--Zener oscillations and quantitatively explaining the observed revival patterns. In the small-photon-number regime, the intrinsic $\sqrt{\bar n+(\cdots)}$ dependence produces a pronounced hopping deformation, namely dimerized couplings that increase along the excitation-number lattice. This deformation reshapes the density of states, enhances collective localization, and generates an energy-resolved spatial bias of the eigenstates. The corresponding real-time dynamics displays direction-dependent anomalous diffusion together with Bloch-like revivals and beat phenomena in selected parameter windows. Our results show that the same cavity--atom platform can realize both emergent ladder spectra and hopping-induced localization in excitation-number space.
papers.title_cn: 超越旋转波近似下腔-原子系统中涌现的 SSH 物理与局域化
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了超越旋转波近似的腔-原子系统，并将其动力学重新表述为激发数基下的有效紧束缚问题。这一与实验相关的光-物质平台在光子数控制下展现出两种不同的区域。在大光子数区域，跃迁振幅变得几乎均匀，有效晶格约化为受线性能量梯度影响的二聚化 SSH 型链。随后能谱组织成一个或两个 Wannier-Stark 阶梯，产生可控的 Bloch 振荡和 Bloch-Zener 振荡，并定量解释了观测到的复现模式。在小光子数区域，内禀的 sqrt(n_bar + (cdots)) 依赖关系产生显著的跃迁形变，即沿激发数晶格增大的二聚化耦合。这种形变重塑了态密度，增强了集体局域化，并产生本征态的能量分辨空间偏置。相应的实时动力学在选定参数窗口内表现出方向依赖的异常扩散以及类 Bloch 复现和拍频现象。我们的结果表明，同一腔-原子平台可以在激发数空间中同时实现涌现的阶梯能谱和跃迁诱导的局域化。

papers.title: Beyond special quasirandom structures: free energies from energy cumulants
papers.abstract: Predicting the finite-temperature stability of a disordered phase requires its free energy. It is traditionally approximated by combining the energy of a special quasirandom structure (a small cell mimicking a random alloy) with the ideal configurational entropy. This approximation neglects the short-range order that develops on cooling. In this study, we show that the conventional approximation is the first term of an infinite expansion of the free energy in energy cumulants. Higher-order cumulants are estimated from energies of random arrangements, without Monte Carlo or molecular dynamics. In a nine-element refractory system, adding the second cumulant reduced free energy errors by about an order of magnitude. The expansion gives phase diagrams with order--disorder transitions, defect concentrations, and short-range order. To demonstrate its utility, we used a foundation interatomic potential to screen lithium-excess rocksalt oxides across 26 elements for synthesizable disordered phases rich in the Li$_4$ clusters needed for lithium percolation. The approach applies to any lattice and chemistry, and brings disordered phases within reach of routine screening.
papers.title_cn: 超越特殊准随机结构：从能量累积量计算自由能
papers.abs_cn: 预测无序相的有限温度稳定性需要其自由能。传统上，自由能通过将特殊准随机结构（一种模拟随机合金的小晶胞）的能量与理想构型熵相结合来近似。这种近似忽略了在冷却过程中形成的短程有序。在本研究中，我们表明传统近似是自由能在能量累积量中无穷展开的第一项。高阶累积量可以从随机排列的能量中估计，无需 Monte Carlo 或分子动力学。在一个九元素难熔体系中，加入第二累积量使自由能误差降低了约一个数量级。该展开给出了具有有序--无序转变、缺陷浓度和短程有序的相图。为了展示其实用性，我们使用基础原子间势在 26 种元素中筛选锂过量岩盐氧化物，以寻找可合成的无序相，这些相富含锂渗流所需的 Li$_4$ 团簇。该方法适用于任何晶格和化学体系，并使无序相进入常规筛选的范围。

papers.title: From GeV to PeV: Orbital Modulation and Wind-Regulated Ultrahigh-energy Emission in Cygnus~X-3
papers.abstract: Recent LHAASO observations reveal ultrahigh-energy (UHE) gamma-ray emission from Cygnus~X-3 with evidence for orbital modulation, providing a rare opportunity to study particle acceleration and transport on binary scales. We develop a common binary--jet model that jointly explains the contemporaneous GeV--PeV spectra and orbital light curves. The GeV emission is produced by anisotropic inverse-Compton scattering of stellar photons by relativistic electrons, while multi-PeV protons escaping from the inner region produce TeV--PeV gamma rays through photohadronic and hadronuclear interactions. The GeV orbital modulation constrains the binary--jet geometry, allowing the UHE observations to probe the escaping proton population and its interaction with the circum-binary environment. We find that the UHE emission is strongly regulated by the accretion-driven wind structure. In the present state, a fast disk wind displaces much of the denser Wolf--Rayet (WR) wind from the escaping-proton trajectories, suppressing hadronuclear emission. Changes in the strength, collimation, or orientation of the disk wind can expose the escaping protons to a much denser WR wind and enhance the PeV gamma-ray luminosity by orders of magnitude. This provides a possible connection to the much brighter, though unconfirmed, PeV activity reported in the 1980s, and links UHE gamma-ray activity to the accretion and outflow state of the binary.
papers.title_cn: 从 GeV 到 PeV：Cygnus~X-3 中的轨道调制与风调控的超高能辐射
papers.abs_cn: 近期 LHAASO 观测揭示了 Cygnus~X-3 的超高能（UHE）伽马射线辐射，并有轨道调制的证据，为研究双星尺度上的粒子加速与输运提供了难得的机会。我们建立了一个统一的双星--喷流模型，能够同时解释同期的 GeV--PeV 能谱和轨道光变曲线。GeV 辐射由相对论电子对星光子的各向异性逆康普顿散射产生，而从内区逃逸的多 PeV 质子通过光强子和强子核相互作用产生 TeV--PeV 伽马射线。GeV 轨道调制约束了双星--喷流几何结构，使得 UHE 观测能够探测逃逸质子群体及其与双星周围环境的相互作用。我们发现，UHE 辐射受到吸积驱动风结构的强烈调控。在当前状态下，快速盘风将大部分较密的 Wolf--Rayet（WR）风从逃逸质子轨迹上排开，抑制了强子核辐射。盘风强度、准直性或方向的变化可以使逃逸质子暴露于密度高得多的 WR 风中，并将 PeV 伽马射线光度提高数个量级。这为 20 世纪 80 年代报道的亮得多但尚未确认的 PeV 活动提供了一种可能的联系，并将 UHE 伽马射线活动与双星的吸积和外流状态联系起来。

papers.title: Warm-Inflation: a software for first-principles integration of warm inflation power spectra
papers.abstract: As part of a PhD thesis entitled `Scalar perturbations in warm inflation and during reheating' we present a software for computing warm inflation observables. In particular, our Mathematica implementation computes the power spectrum, spectral tilt, and tensor-to-scalar ratio for a given momentum scale. Compared with other implementations, we start in a Bunch-Davies state deep inside the horizon, ideally at a time when thermal noise is exponentially suppressed. We integrate gauge-invariant equations for three curvature perturbations across horizon exit. We continue deep enough outside of horizon so that all curvature perturbations agree. Results are illustrated for Standard Model embedded warm inflation, and we also provide notebooks for several other popular potentials and friction coefficients. The theoretical foundations for the code can be found in the main part of the thesis or in earlier papers [1,2]. Specifically, part II derives gauge-invariant, model-agnostic evolution equations, as well as the noise autocorrelator interpolating between quantum and classical domains. Part III presents the general ideas behind the numerical implementation, while part IV presents selected results. The code is described, line-by-line, in Appendix A. The published PhD thesis is available at https://doi.org/10.48620/101166 while the notebooks can be downloaded from https://github.com/alicarogeljblackhole/Warm-Inflation.
papers.title_cn: Warm-Inflation：一个用于暖暴胀功率谱第一性原理积分的软件
papers.abs_cn: 作为题为“暖暴胀及重加热期间的标量扰动”的博士论文的一部分，我们提出了一个用于计算暖暴胀可观测量的软件。具体而言，我们的 Mathematica 实现针对给定的动量尺度计算功率谱、谱指数和张量标量比。与其他实现相比，我们从视界深处、理想情况下热噪声被指数抑制的时刻的 Bunch-Davies 态出发。我们对三个曲率扰动的规范不变方程进行积分，跨越视界退出。我们继续积分到视界外足够深处，使得所有曲率扰动一致。结果以标准模型嵌入的暖暴胀为例进行展示，我们还为其他几种流行的势和摩擦系数提供了 notebook。该代码的理论基础可在论文的主体部分或早期论文 [1,2] 中找到。具体而言，第二部分推导了规范不变、模型无关的演化方程，以及在量子和经典域之间插值的噪声自关联函数。第三部分介绍了数值实现背后的一般思想，而第四部分展示了部分结果。代码在附录 A 中逐行描述。已发表的博士论文可在 https://doi.org/10.48620/101166 获取，而 notebook 可从 https://github.com/alicarogeljblackhole/Warm-Inflation 下载。

papers.title: Benchmarking Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials for Temperature-Dependent Elasticity of Binary and High-Entropy Refractory Carbides
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of temperature-dependent elasticity is important for assessing refractory carbides under high-temperature conditions, but the computational cost of ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) limits systematic investigations across compositions and temperatures. Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) offer an efficient alternative, yet their accuracy for this task remains insufficiently established. Here, we benchmark nine uMLIPs against consistent AIMD reference data for five binary and two high-entropy (HE) carbides between 300 and 1200 K. Elastic constants and the corresponding bulk, shear, and Young's moduli are obtained using stress-strain molecular dynamics, explicitly sampling thermal atomic motion and anharmonic effects beyond thermal expansion alone. We assess absolute elastic properties and normalized thermal softening separately. MACE-MH-1 achieves the lowest overall mean absolute percentage error (5.7%). MACE-MH-1 and DPA4-Mini reproduce thermal softening most accurately, with mean deviations of 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points, respectively. All models generally underestimate stiffness, with larger equilibrium volumes relative to the AIMD reference likely contributing to this trend for most models. C12 exhibits the largest model-dependent errors. The HE carbides are described with accuracy comparable to that of the binary carbides, indicating no apparent accuracy penalty from chemical complexity. Accuracy instead varies with transition-metal composition, with group-V carbides, particularly TaC, presenting the greatest challenge. These results identify promising pretrained models for finite-temperature elasticity in carbides and show why accurate absolute stiffness and thermal softening must be assessed independently.
papers.title_cn: 基准测试通用机器学习原子间势对二元及高熵难熔碳化物温度依赖性弹性的预测
papers.abs_cn: 准确预测温度依赖性弹性对于评估高温条件下的难熔碳化物很重要，但从头算分子动力学（AIMD）的计算成本限制了跨成分和温度的系统研究。通用机器学习原子间势（uMLIPs）提供了一种高效替代方案，但其在此任务中的准确性仍未得到充分确立。在此，我们针对五种二元和两种高熵（HE）碳化物在300至1200 K之间的一致AIMD参考数据，对九种uMLIPs进行了基准测试。弹性常数以及相应的体积模量、剪切模量和杨氏模量通过应力-应变分子动力学获得，明确采样了热原子运动以及热膨胀之外的anharmonic效应。我们分别评估绝对弹性性质和归一化热软化。MACE-MH-1实现了最低的总体平均绝对百分比误差（5.7%）。MACE-MH-1和DPA4-Mini最准确地再现了热软化，平均偏差分别为2.5和2.3个百分点。所有模型通常都低估了刚度，相对于AIMD参考更大的平衡体积可能是大多数模型出现这一趋势的原因。C12表现出最大的模型依赖性误差。HE碳化物的描述精度与二元碳化物相当，表明化学复杂性没有带来明显的精度损失。相反，精度随过渡金属成分而变化，其中第V族碳化物，尤其是TaC，构成了最大的挑战。这些结果确定了有前景的预训练模型用于碳化物有限温度弹性，并说明了为什么必须独立评估绝对刚度和热软化。

papers.title: Sharing of Gaussian tripartite steering in de-Sitter space
papers.abstract: We investigate the redistribution and directional properties of Gaussian tripartite quantum steering in de-Sitter space within the continuous-variable framework. By expressing the Bunch-Davies vacuum in terms of the open-chart modes through a Bogoliubov transformation, we derive the covariance matrix of the resulting multipartite Gaussian state and analyze both one-to-two and two-to-one steering configurations. We find that de-Sitter curvature generally suppresses the steering initially shared among the accessible modes, but its influence depends strongly on the steering direction. In particular, while some steering configurations undergo sudden death at finite curvature, two-to-one steering toward a nongravitational mode remains finite throughout the parameter range considered, demonstrating a robustness of tripartite steering absent in its bipartite counterpart. Remarkably, the maximum steering asymmetry occurs at the critical point at which steering in one direction undergoes sudden death, marking the transition from two-way to one-way steering. We further show that the de-Sitter gravitational field can generate tripartite steering involving modes separated by the cosmological horizon. Depending on the steering partition, this curvature-induced steering exhibits persistent one-way or asymmetric two-way behavior, as well as a sudden-birth transition from one-way to two-way steering. These results demonstrate that de-Sitter curvature not only degrades preexisting quantum correlations but also redistributes and generates directional multipartite steering across causally disconnected regions.
papers.title_cn: 德西特空间中高斯三方 steering 的共享
papers.abs_cn: 我们在连续变量框架下研究了德西特空间中高斯三方量子 steering 的再分配和方向性性质。通过 Bogoliubov 变换将 Bunch-Davies 真空用开图模式表示，我们推导了所得多体高斯态的协方差矩阵，并分析了一对二和二对一两种 steering 构型。我们发现，德西特曲率通常会抑制可及模式之间最初共享的 steering，但其影响强烈依赖于 steering 的方向。特别地，虽然某些 steering 构型在有限曲率下经历突然死亡，但朝向非引力模式的二对一 steering 在所考虑的整个参数范围内保持有限，这表明三方 steering 具有二分情形中所没有的鲁棒性。值得注意的是，最大 steering 不对称性出现在一个方向的 steering 经历突然死亡的临界点，标志着从双向 steering 到单向 steering 的转变。我们进一步表明，德西特引力场可以产生涉及被宇宙视界分隔的模式的三方 steering。取决于 steering 划分，这种曲率诱导的 steering 表现出持续的单向或不对称双向行为，以及从单向到双向 steering 的突然诞生转变。这些结果表明，德西特曲率不仅会退化预先存在的量子关联，还会在因果不相连区域之间再分配并产生方向性多体 steering。

papers.title: Explicit upper bounds on the threshold of one-dimensional long-range percolation
papers.abstract: We study bond percolation on the one-dimensional lattice in which two sites at distance $r$ are connected with probability $p_r=C/r^{1+σ}$, where $0 < σ< 1$. An infinite cluster exists if $C$ exceeds a critical value $C_c(σ)$, which is not known exactly: the available results are the lower bound of Schulman, $C_c\ge1/[2ζ(1+σ)]$, and numerical estimates. Here we prove explicit upper bounds. We apply a second-moment argument to a family of random monotone paths whose steps have a heavy-tailed (Sibuya) distribution. Two such paths meet only a finite number of times, and their overlap is computed exactly by renewal theory. The result is a closed-form bound, which gives $C_c\leσ+O(σ^2)$ as $σ\to0$ and is below $1$ for $σ< 0.667$. Since the paths are monotone, the bound holds also for oriented percolation, and it determines the oriented threshold asymptotically: $C_c^{\rightarrow}ζ(1+σ)\to1$ as $σ\to0$. A coarse-grained version of the argument, with blocks of sites in place of sites, gives an explicit bound $C_c < 1$ for every $σ< 1$. We compare the bounds with the known numerical values of $C_c$.
papers.title_cn: 一维长程渗流阈值的显式上界
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究一维晶格上的键渗流，其中距离为 $r$ 的两个格点以概率 $p_r=C/r^{1+σ}$ 相连，其中 $0 < σ< 1$。当 $C$ 超过临界值 $C_c(σ)$ 时存在无限簇，但该临界值没有精确解：现有结果包括 Schulman 的下界 $C_c\ge1/[2ζ(1+σ)]$ 以及数值估计。本文证明了显式上界。我们将二阶矩方法应用于一族随机单调路径，其步长服从重尾（Sibuya）分布。两条这样的路径只相交有限次，其重叠部分可由更新理论精确计算。结果是一个闭式界，当 $σ\to0$ 时给出 $C_c\leσ+O(σ^2)$，且当 $σ< 0.667$ 时该界小于 $1$。由于路径是单调的，该界对定向渗流也成立，并确定了定向阈值的渐近行为：当 $σ\to0$ 时 $C_c^{\rightarrow}ζ(1+σ)\to1$。该论证的粗粒化版本以格点块代替格点，对每个 $σ< 1$ 给出显式界 $C_c < 1$。我们将这些界与已知的 $C_c$ 数值进行比较。

papers.title: From Majorana to Bloch: two ways to generalize the Bloch sphere representation
papers.abstract: While the Bloch sphere provides a canonical geometric representation for qubits, its generalization to pure qudit states ($d>2$) is not unique. This representation can be extended following two different approaches: increasing the number of points, as in the Majorana representation, or using a single point but in a space of larger dimension, as in the generalized Bloch representation. In this work, we compare these representations of pure qudit states by finding explicit analytical relations between them. In particular, a general formula of the Bloch vector in terms of the Majorana points of a given state is provided. We also analyze some suitable extensions of these representations in the case of pure permutation-symmetric two- and three-qubit states, deriving the corresponding relation between them. These analytical results allow us to study, from a geometric point of view, quantum correlations of special classes of two-qubit states.
papers.title_cn: 从 Majorana 到 Bloch：推广 Bloch 球表示的两种方式
papers.abs_cn: 虽然 Bloch 球为量子比特提供了一种标准的几何表示，但其对纯 qudit 态（d>2）的推广并不唯一。这种表示可以沿两条不同路径扩展：增加点的数量，如 Majorana 表示；或者使用单个点，但置于更高维空间中，如广义 Bloch 表示。在本工作中，我们通过找到它们之间的显式解析关系，比较了纯 qudit 态的这两种表示。特别地，我们给出了给定态的 Bloch 向量用其 Majorana 点表示的一般公式。我们还分析了这些表示在纯置换对称的二量子比特和三量子比特态情形下的一些合适扩展，并推导了它们之间的相应关系。这些解析结果使我们能够从几何角度研究特殊类别二量子比特态的量子关联。

papers.title: Extended Results on Absorbing Boundary Conditions as Limits of Complex Potentials
papers.abstract: In quantum mechanics, among the proposals for how to compute the probability distribution of detection time and place along a given spatial surface or in a given volume, two leading candidates involve absorbing boundary conditions (ABCs) and complex absorbing potentials (CAPs) for the Schrödinger equation. Here, we extend earlier results on how the two are related. It was previously shown that ABCs arise as a limiting case of CAPs, but for that a (reflecting) Neumann boundary condition was assumed at the end of the region with the CAP. Here, we obtain ABCs in a different limit using a Dirichlet boundary condition at the end of the CAP region, which seems more practically relevant and realizable.
papers.title_cn: 吸收边界条件作为复势极限的扩展结果
papers.abs_cn: 在量子力学中，关于如何计算沿给定空间曲面或给定体积内探测时间和位置的概率分布，两个主要候选方案涉及薛定谔方程的吸收边界条件（ABCs）和复吸收势（CAPs）。在此，我们扩展了关于两者如何关联的早期结果。此前已表明，ABCs 作为 CAPs 的极限情况出现，但那时假设在 CAP 区域的末端采用（反射）Neumann 边界条件。在这里，我们使用 CAP 区域末端的 Dirichlet 边界条件在另一个极限下获得了 ABCs，这似乎更具实际相关性和可实现性。

papers.title: Electromagnetic isospin breaking in hadronic vacuum polarization within a VMD model
papers.abstract: One of the challenging components of modern lattice-QCD computations of the leading hadronic vacuum polarization contribution to the muon $(g-2)_μ$ is the isospin-breaking correction due to electromagnetism. Dominated by long distances, this correction suffers from severe signal-to-noise issues and finite-volume effects. To provide infinite-volume benchmarks for various quark-level Wick contractions, we estimate their sizes phenomenologically at the physical point, using a previously developed vector-meson-dominance model. The pion contributions in this model sum to around $-7.1\times 10^{-10}$, dominated by the electromagnetic pion mass shift. The ultraviolet-finite (2+2)a ("dumbbell") contraction accounts for approximately two thirds of this model sum; for both, about 30% comes from Euclidean times beyond 2.8 fm.
papers.title_cn: VMD 模型中强子真空极化的电磁同位旋破缺
papers.abs_cn: 在现代格点 QCD 计算 μ 子 $(g-2)_μ$ 领头强子真空极化贡献时，一个具有挑战性的组成部分是电磁引起的同位旋破缺修正。该修正由长程主导，存在严重的信噪比问题和有限体积效应。为了给各种夸克层次的 Wick 收缩提供无限体积基准，我们使用先前发展的矢量介子主导模型，在物理点唯象地估计它们的大小。该模型中 pion 贡献总和约为 $-7.1\times 10^{-10}$，主要由电磁 pion 质量移动主导。紫外有限的 (2+2)a（“哑铃”）收缩约占该模型总和的三分之二；对于两者，约 30% 来自超过 2.8 fm 的欧几里得时间。

papers.title: Tunable Ultrastrong Magnon-Magnon Coupling and Squeezed States in a Triaxial Van der Waals Antiferromagnet
papers.abstract: Achieving and quantifying ultrastrong magnon-magnon coupling (USC) remains a key challenge for quantum magnonics. Here, we demonstrate widely tunable USC between chiral (right- and left-handed) and acoustic or optical magnon modes in the van der Waals antiferromagnet $CrPS_4$. Using a full quantum model, we decompose the interaction into three microscopic interaction channels: the co-rotating term $g_1$ (mode hybridization), the counter-rotating term $g_2$ (two-mode squeezing), and, uniquely in the chiral regime, the self-squared term $g_3$ that mediates single-mode squeezing. The normalized coupling ratio reaches $g/f_g$ $\sim$ 0.41, entering the USC regime. Most significantly, we establish a complete protocol linking these USC parameters to a measurable quantum phenomenon: a squeezed magnon vacuum state. Our simulations not only visualize the chirality and polarization evolution of the hybrid modes but also demonstrate how to directly extract quadrature fluctuations and a substantial squeezing factor (up to $\sim$ 9.7 dB) from thermal noise-driven magnetization dynamics. This work provides a material-specific quantum framework for USC and a practical pathway to detect and exploit non-classical magnon states in low-damping two-dimensional magnets, opening a route toward quantum-enhanced spintronics and hybrid quantum information platforms.
papers.title_cn: 三轴范德华反铁磁体中的可调超强磁振子-磁振子耦合与压缩态
papers.abs_cn: 实现并量化超强磁振子-磁振子耦合（USC）仍然是量子磁子学的关键挑战。在此，我们展示了范德华反铁磁体 CrPS4 中手性（右旋和左旋）与声学或光学磁振子模式之间广泛可调的 USC。使用全量子模型，我们将相互作用分解为三个微观相互作用通道：共旋转项 g1（模式杂化）、反旋转项 g2（双模压缩），以及手性区域中独有的自平方项 g3，后者介导单模压缩。归一化耦合比达到 g/f_g ~ 0.41，进入 USC 区域。最重要的是，我们建立了一套完整的方案，将这些 USC 参数与可测量的量子现象联系起来：压缩磁振子真空态。我们的模拟不仅可视化了杂化模式的手性和偏振演化，还展示了如何从热噪声驱动的磁化动力学中直接提取正交涨落和显著的压缩因子（高达 ~ 9.7 dB）。这项工作为 USC 提供了一个材料特定的量子框架，并为在低阻尼二维磁体中探测和利用非经典磁振子态提供了一条实用途径，为量子增强自旋电子学和混合量子信息平台开辟了道路。

papers.title: Testing Extra-Dimensional Gravitational-Wave Polarizations with Compact-Binary Observations
papers.abstract: Extra spatial dimensions arise naturally in theories beyond four-dimensional general relativity (GR), but direct observational evidence remains elusive. Gravitational waves offer a distinctive probe: geometric projection onto the observable three-dimensional spatial subspace can produce apparent tensor, vector, and scalar polarizations. We consider one additional spatial dimension and a two-mode tensor-wave ansatz for which the projected polarization components are fixed linear combinations of the same two underlying GR tensor waveforms. These components enter the measured strain through the standard detector antenna patterns. A frequency-domain Bayesian analysis of five compact-binary events constrains two rotation angles for two noncommuting orderings of rotations that preserve propagation within the observed subspace. Two events are further analyzed for four orderings that allow propagation to tilt into the extra dimension. For GW250114, the maximum GR quantiles among the tested rotation orderings are $Q_{\mathrm{GR}}\simeq0.6\%$ for the two-angle fits and $Q^{\mathrm{marg}}_{\mathrm{GR}}\simeq4.6\%$ for the three-angle fits after marginalizing over the third angle. Across the full event sample, the GR reference point lies inside the estimated 90% highest-posterior-density region in every case.
papers.title_cn: 利用致密双星观测检验额外维度引力波偏振
papers.abs_cn: 额外空间维度自然出现在超越四维广义相对论（GR）的理论中，但直接的观测证据仍然难以获得。引力波提供了一种独特的探针：向可观测三维空间子空间的几何投影可以产生表观的张量、矢量和标量偏振。我们考虑一个额外空间维度和一个双模张量波假设，其中投影后的偏振分量是同一对 underlying GR 张量波形的固定线性组合。这些分量通过标准探测器天线模式进入测量到的应变。对五个致密双星事件的频域贝叶斯分析约束了两个旋转角，对应于保持传播在观测子空间内的两种非对易旋转顺序。对两个事件进一步分析了允许传播倾斜进入额外维度的四种顺序。对于 GW250114，在所测试的旋转顺序中，最大 GR 分位数为两角拟合的 Q_GR ≃ 0.6%，以及在对第三个角度边缘化后三角拟合的 Q^marg_GR ≃ 4.6%。在整个事件样本中，GR 参考点在每种情况下都位于估计的 90% 最高后验密度区域内。

papers.title: Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry
papers.abstract: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.
papers.title_cn: 从分次泊松几何看 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力
papers.abs_cn: 利用分次泊松几何中的概念，我们发展了一个框架，能够简洁地表述诸如 Einstein-Cartan 和 Palatini-Cartan 引力等场论。我们证明 Einstein-Cartan 引力等价于 Palatini-Cartan 引力的一个变体，其中 vielbein 场被约束为满足适当的对称关系，我们称之为约束 vielbein 引力。为此，我们通过分次流形的微分同胚将这些理论联系起来。随后我们展示了如何通过移除对称约束来获得完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们展示了我们的分次几何框架如何能够直接纳入分次约束 vielbein 和 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩张。

papers.title: Searching for Charged Lepton Flavor Violation
papers.abstract: Searches for Charged Lepton Flavor Violation (CLFV) are powerful tools to probe physics beyond the Standard Model (BSM). This chapter provides a comprehensive survey of CLFV theory, focusing primarily on low-energy muon and tau transitions while outlining complementary searches from high-energy colliders. Grounded in the Effective Field Theory (EFT) framework, we systematically review key observables including radiative and purely leptonic decays of muon and tau as well as $μ\to e$ conversion in nuclei and $τ$ hadronic decay channels. CLFV involving light new physics particles is also discussed. This review captures the modern synergy between EFTs, novel light-mediator scenarios, and hadronic and nuclear physics in the ongoing hunt for BSM signals.
papers.title_cn: 寻找带电轻子味破坏
papers.abs_cn: 寻找带电轻子味破坏（CLFV）是探测超出标准模型（BSM）物理的有力工具。本章对CLFV理论进行了全面综述，主要聚焦于低能μ子和τ子跃迁，同时概述了高能对撞机的互补搜索。基于有效场论（EFT）框架，我们系统回顾了关键观测量，包括μ子和τ子的辐射衰变与纯轻子衰变，以及原子核中的μ->e转换和τ强子衰变道。还讨论了涉及轻新物理粒子的CLFV。本综述涵盖了EFT、新型轻媒介子情景以及强子与核物理在持续寻找BSM信号中的现代协同作用。

papers.title: Magnon band splitting without altermagnetism in CuF2
papers.abstract: Conclusive identification of an altermagnetic state requires going beyond mere symmetry arguments. We illustrate this in a combined computational and experimental study of the rutile-like material CuF$_2$, which is on the list of predicted altermagnets. Using ab initio and linear spin-wave calculations supplied by magnetization measurements, we show that CuF$_2$ in its experimental monoclinic structure can be described by a spin-$\frac12$ model of weakly coupled square-lattice layers with the in-plane coupling $J_1\simeq 115$ K and two synergistic antiferromagnetic interplane couplings amounting to 4% and 8% of $J_1$, respectively. Driven by long-range superexchange, these interlayer couplings are oblique to the square planes, resulting in the unit-cell doubling in the magnetically ordered state, thus effectively suppressing any altermagnetic band splitting. Concurrently, we identify unusually strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, $|\mathbf D|/J_1\simeq 0.3$, that produce spin canting and, together with order-by-disorder effect, pin the Néel vector to the crystallographic $b$-axis. Additionally, DM anisotropy promotes magnon band splitting, but these bands remain non-chiral. Our results highlight the importance of relativistic effects even in $3d$ magnets with altermagnetic symmetries.
papers.title_cn: CuF2中无交错磁性的磁振子能带分裂
papers.abs_cn: 要确凿地识别交错磁态，需要超越单纯的对称性论证。我们通过对类金红石材料CuF2的计算与实验联合研究来说明这一点，该材料在预测的交错磁体列表中。利用从头算和线性自旋波计算，并结合磁化测量，我们表明实验单斜结构中的CuF2可以用一个自旋-1/2模型来描述，该模型包含弱耦合的方格子层，面内耦合J1约为115 K，以及两个协同的反铁磁层间耦合，分别相当于J1的4%和8%。由长程超交换驱动，这些层间耦合相对于方格平面是倾斜的，导致磁有序态中晶胞加倍，从而有效抑制了任何交错磁能带分裂。同时，我们识别出异常强的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，|D|/J1约为0.3，它产生自旋倾斜，并与无序有序效应一起将Néel矢量钉扎到晶体学b轴。此外，DM各向异性促进磁振子能带分裂，但这些能带保持非手性。我们的结果凸显了即使在具有交错磁对称性的3d磁体中，相对论效应的重要性。

papers.title: Investigating the nature of magnetic turbulence in Tycho's SNR using X-ray observation
papers.abstract: Supernova remnants (SNRs) are widely regarded as the primary sources of Galactic cosmic ray acceleration and the particles are energized at the shock front of SNRs through the diffusive shock acceleration (DSA) mechanism, gaining energy by repeatedly crossing the shock. Magnetic turbulence plays a crucial role in scattering these particles back and forth, making the investigation of turbulence essential to understanding the acceleration process. In this study, we apply the two-point correlation method to derive the magnetic energy spectrum from the non-thermal X-ray flux image of Tycho's SNR. This image was obtained using Poissonian-based Generalized Morphological Component Analysis (pGMCA). The turbulence length scale observed in the resulting spectrum is shorter than the turbulence scale derived from previous studies of radio observations of Tycho's SNR. Additionally, we use the X-ray rim thickness measured across Tycho which is an indicator of magnetic field strength to estimate the magnetic energy spectrum. The turbulence scale inferred from this method is consistent with that obtained from the non-thermal X-ray flux analysis.
papers.title_cn: 利用X射线观测研究Tycho超新星遗迹中磁湍流的性质
papers.abs_cn: 超新星遗迹（SNRs）被广泛认为是银河系宇宙线加速的主要来源，粒子通过扩散激波加速（DSA）机制在SNRs的激波前沿获得能量，通过反复穿越激波来增加能量。磁湍流在使这些粒子来回散射中起着至关重要的作用，因此研究湍流对于理解加速过程至关重要。在本研究中，我们应用两点相关方法从Tycho超新星遗迹的非热X射线通量图像中推导磁能谱。该图像是使用基于泊松的广义形态成分分析（pGMCA）获得的。在所得能谱中观测到的湍流长度尺度比先前从Tycho超新星遗迹射电观测研究中推导出的湍流尺度要短。此外，我们使用在Tycho上测量的X射线边缘厚度——这是磁场强度的指标——来估计磁能谱。通过这种方法推断出的湍流尺度与从非热X射线通量分析中获得的结果一致。

papers.title: Controlling transitions between nonequilibrium states through active bath engineering
papers.abstract: We develop a family of control protocols for finite-time transitions between active nonequilibrium steady states using the noise-color (correlation rate) as the sole control parameter. By reverse-engineering the second moment dynamics of an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, we determine the time-dependent correlation rate required to realize a prescribed evolution of the system's state. We experimentally implement these protocols with a micrometer-sized optically trapped particle coupled to an engineered active bath, demonstrating transitions substantially faster than the natural relaxation while keeping the confining potential, noise amplitude, and temperature fixed. Our approach extends engineered swift-equilibration methods to far-from-equilibrium steady states by directly controlling the temporal correlations of an active environment. We show how physical constraints impose a speed limit on finite-time transitions, while the freedom in choosing the prescribed system evolution can be exploited to eliminate control discontinuities, minimize the admissible transition time, or optimize a thermodynamic cost.
papers.title_cn: 通过主动浴工程控制非平衡态之间的转变
papers.abs_cn: 我们开发了一族控制协议，用于在主动非平衡稳态之间实现有限时间转变，其中以噪声色（关联速率）作为唯一的控制参数。通过逆向工程主动 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程的二阶矩动力学，我们确定了实现系统状态预定演化所需的时间依赖关联速率。我们利用一个微米级的光镊捕获粒子与工程化主动浴耦合，实验实现了这些协议，展示了在保持约束势、噪声幅度和温度固定的情况下，转变速度显著快于自然弛豫。我们的方法通过直接控制主动环境的时间关联，将工程化快速平衡方法推广到远离平衡的稳态。我们展示了物理约束如何对有限时间转变施加速度限制，同时选择预定系统演化的自由度可用于消除控制不连续性、最小化允许的转变时间或优化热力学成本。

papers.title: Solution-Based Synthesis of Fe-Co-Ni Prussian Blue Analogue Powders: A Comparative Structural, Spectroscopic and Thermal Study
papers.abstract: Prussian Blue (Fe-PBA) and its Co and Ni analogues (Co-PBA and Ni-PBA) were synthesized by an additive-free aqueous co-precipitation route using K$_4$[Fe(CN)$_6$] and FeCl$_3$, CoCl$_2$, or NiCl$_2$, respectively. The three powders were systematically compared by X-ray diffraction, ATR-FTIR and Raman spectroscopy, FEG-SEM/EDS, and TG/SDTA. All compositions exhibit the characteristic cubic cyanide-bridged PBA framework, with apparent lattice parameters of 10.10 +/- 0.02, 10.01 +/- 0.02, and 10.10 +/- 0.03 Angstrom for Fe-PBA, Co-PBA, and Ni-PBA, respectively. The dominant C$\equiv$N stretching band in ATR-FTIR shifts from 2062 to 2071 and 2087 cm$^{-1}$ across the Fe-Co-Ni series, indicating composition-dependent changes in the local cyanide environment. Fe-PBA contains less potassium than the Co- and Ni-containing powders and exhibits a substantially larger low-temperature mass loss. Sharp reflections assigned to crystalline KCl are observed in all three diffraction patterns, while additional unassigned reflections in Ni-PBA indicate the presence of at least one further crystalline phase. These results show that differences among Fe-, Co-, and Ni-based PBAs cannot be attributed solely to transition-metal identity, as precursor oxidation state and washing efficiency also influence the composition and thermal response of the resulting powders.
papers.title_cn: 基于溶液法合成 Fe-Co-Ni 普鲁士蓝类似物粉末：结构、光谱与热学性质的对比研究
papers.abs_cn: 采用无添加剂的水相共沉淀法，分别以 K4[Fe(CN)6] 与 FeCl3、CoCl2 或 NiCl2 为原料，合成了普鲁士蓝（Fe-PBA）及其 Co 和 Ni 类似物（Co-PBA 和 Ni-PBA）。通过 X 射线衍射、ATR-FTIR 和拉曼光谱、FEG-SEM/EDS 以及 TG/SDTA 对三种粉末进行了系统对比。所有组成均呈现典型的立方氰基桥连 PBA 骨架，Fe-PBA、Co-PBA 和 Ni-PBA 的表观晶格参数分别为 10.10 +/- 0.02、10.01 +/- 0.02 和 10.10 +/- 0.03 Angstrom。ATR-FTIR 中占主导的 C≡N 伸缩振动带在 Fe-Co-Ni 系列中从 2062 位移至 2071 和 2087 cm-1，表明局部氰基环境随组成变化。Fe-PBA 的钾含量低于含 Co 和 Ni 的粉末，并表现出显著更大的低温质量损失。三种衍射图谱中均观察到归属于结晶 KCl 的尖锐反射，而 Ni-PBA 中额外的未归属反射表明至少还存在一种其他结晶相。这些结果表明，Fe、Co 和 Ni 基 PBA 之间的差异不能仅归因于过渡金属种类，前驱体氧化态和洗涤效率也会影响所得粉末的组成和热响应。

papers.title: The Hand of God Revisited: Revealing the Shell Structure and Jet-Supernova Remnant Interaction in MSH 15-52
papers.abstract: We present an X-ray analysis of the supernova remnant (SNR) MSH 15-52 associated with the young rotation-powered pulsar PSR B1509-58, using Chandra, XMM-Newton, and eROSITA, complemented by MeerKAT radio data. We report the discovery of the missing southern counterpart to the bright northern RCW 89 region and identify a foreground X-ray source that may be a previously unidentified SNR candidate. Imaging and spectroscopy with XMM-Newton and eROSITA reveal the shell properties of MSH 15-52 and suggest that both the southern and northern shell-like structures are consistent with shocked interstellar medium associated with the forward shock, while their low ionization timescales and possible hard power-law components indicate possible influence from particle injection or additional heating by the pulsar wind nebula (PWN) jets. New Chandra spectral maps of the southern jet reveal a region of hard non-thermal emission, with a photon index of approximately 1.6, suggesting interaction between the PWN and the reverse shock and possible re-acceleration of the pulsar outflow. Spatially resolved spectroscopy of the RCW 89 northern clumps reveals high-velocity, metal-rich ejecta with enhanced Ne and Mg abundances. Comparison with core-collapse nucleosynthesis models favors a massive progenitor with an initial mass of approximately 29 solar masses in one-dimensional yield models, while asymmetric explosion models show that lower-mass progenitors can also reproduce the observed abundance ratios. Our study supports a picture in which RCW 89 is part of a larger asymmetric SNR shell interacting with energetic pulsar jets, making the system a valuable laboratory for probing pulsar-PWN-SNR interaction.
papers.title_cn: 重访上帝之手：揭示MSH 15-52的壳层结构与喷流-超新星遗迹相互作用
papers.abs_cn: 我们利用Chandra、XMM-Newton和eROSITA，并辅以MeerKAT射电数据，对与年轻自转供能脉冲星PSR B1509-58成协的超新星遗迹（SNR）MSH 15-52进行了X射线分析。我们报告发现了北部明亮RCW 89区域在南侧缺失的对应结构，并识别出一个前景X射线源，其可能是一个此前未被确认的SNR候选体。利用XMM-Newton和eROSITA进行的成像与光谱分析揭示了MSH 15-52的壳层性质，并表明南部和北部的壳层状结构均与伴随前向激波的热化星际介质一致，而其较低的电离时标以及可能的硬幂律成分则表明可能受到粒子注入或脉冲星风云（PWN）喷流额外加热的影响。新的Chandra南部喷流光谱图揭示出一个硬非热辐射区域，其光子指数约为1.6，表明PWN与反向激波之间存在相互作用，以及脉冲星外流可能被再加速。对RCW 89北部团块的空间分辨光谱分析揭示出高速、富金属的抛射物，其中Ne和Mg丰度增强。与核心坍缩核合成模型的比较表明，在一维产额模型中，倾向于初始质量约为29个太阳质量的大质量前身星，而非对称爆炸模型则显示质量较低的前身星也能再现观测到的丰度比。我们的研究支持这样一种图景：RCW 89是一个更大的非对称SNR壳层的一部分，并与高能脉冲星喷流相互作用，使该系统成为探测脉冲星-PWN-SNR相互作用的宝贵实验室。

papers.title: Photoinduced Odd- and Mixed-Parity Magnetism in Collinear Antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnetism, characterized by compensated collinear magnetic moments in real space and momentum-dependent spin splitting with even-parity symmetry, has recently emerged as a distinct form of magnetic order beyond the conventional ferro- and antiferromagnetic paradigms. However, realizing odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in fully compensated collinear magnets remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that light irradiation can induce odd- and mixed-parity magnetism in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Taking monolayer CoS and CoSe as representative systems, and combining Floquet theory with first-principles calculations, we show that circularly polarized light (CPL) induces odd-parity $f$-wave spin splitting, whereas elliptically polarized light (EPL) induces odd-parity $p$-wave spin splitting. Uniaxial strain combined with CPL provides an alternative route to realizing the $p$-wave state. More remarkably, applying an electric field together with CPL or EPL transforms the spin splitting into mixed-parity forms. The light-induced breaking of $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetry, together with spin-orbit coupling, further gives rise to a finite anomalous Hall response. Our work establishes a versatile strategy for engineering odd- and mixed-parity spin splitting in compensated antiferromagnets, offering a route toward light-controlled electronic and magnetic phenomena.
papers.title_cn: 共线反铁磁体中的光诱导奇宇称与混合宇称磁性
papers.abs_cn: 交错磁性（altermagnetism）以实空间中补偿的共线磁矩和具有偶宇称对称性的动量依赖自旋劈裂为特征，近来作为一种超越传统铁磁和反铁磁范式的独特磁有序形式而出现。然而，在完全补偿的共线磁体中实现奇宇称和混合宇称磁性仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们证明光照射可以在常规共线反铁磁体中诱导奇宇称和混合宇称磁性。以单层 CoS 和 CoSe 作为代表性体系，并结合 Floquet 理论与第一性原理计算，我们表明圆偏振光（CPL）诱导奇宇称 f 波自旋劈裂，而椭圆偏振光（EPL）诱导奇宇称 p 波自旋劈裂。单轴应变与 CPL 结合提供了实现 p 波态的替代途径。更引人注目的是，施加电场与 CPL 或 EPL 相结合会将自旋劈裂转变为混合宇称形式。光诱导的 PT 对称性破缺与自旋轨道耦合一起进一步产生了有限的异常霍尔响应。我们的工作建立了一种在补偿反铁磁体中工程化奇宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂的通用策略，为光控电子和磁现象提供了一条途径。

papers.title: Connected Geometries in Gravitational Path Integrals, and Normalized No-Boundary Probabilities
papers.abstract: We argue that some of the puzzling features associated with the normalization of gravitational wave functions can be substantially alleviated by restricting the path integral to a sum over connected, allowable geometries. This prescription gives sensible results when applied to classical transitions and it provides non-trivial no-boundary probabilities, in line with old expectations. We highlight the additional impact of both boundary conditions and integration contours on these issues.
papers.title_cn: 引力路径积分中的连通几何与归一化无边界概率
papers.abs_cn: 我们认为，通过将路径积分限制为对连通、允许几何的求和，可以大幅缓解与引力波函数归一化相关的一些令人困惑的特征。这一规定在应用于经典跃迁时给出了合理的结果，并且提供了非平凡的无边界概率，与早先的预期一致。我们强调了边界条件和积分围道对这些问题各自额外的影​​响。

papers.title: Minimally Modified Frampton--Glashow--Yanagida Ansatz and Its Leptogenesis Consequences: In Light of Recent JUNO's Result
papers.abstract: Motivated by the recent JUNO indication favoring normal neutrino mass ordering, we study two realizations of the minimally modified Frampton--Glashow--Yanagida (MMFGY) framework in the minimal type-I seesaw with two right-handed neutrinos. Both retain one exact Yukawa texture zero, supplemented by either a single physical CP-violating phase or a remnant CP symmetry. The explicit-CP realization yields twelve high-energy Yukawa configurations that reduce to three low-energy classes, with correlated CP phases and predictions for neutrinoless double-beta decay. In both realizations, a strongly suppressed second Yukawa entry can emerge, although the full-matrix hierarchy remains moderate in the quasi-degenerate regime. We analyze leptogenesis for a non-degenerate benchmark, quasi-degenerate TeV-scale right-handed neutrinos, and lower masses where coherent production, oscillations, and electroweak sphaleron freeze-out become important. Successful leptogenesis is obtained across a broad range of the scanned benchmarks, with increased sensitivity to the initial right-handed-neutrino abundance at the lowest mass scale. Requiring successful leptogenesis restricts the allowed phases while preserving the possibility of an approximate second zero. The two realizations exhibit distinct approximate-zero patterns and leptogenesis predictions, demonstrating how different restrictions on the high-energy Yukawa structure affect baryogenesis.
papers.title_cn: 最小修改的 Frampton--Glashow--Yanagida Ansatz 及其 leptogenesis 后果：基于近期 JUNO 结果
papers.abs_cn: 受近期 JUNO 倾向于正常中微子质量排序的迹象启发，我们研究了最小修改的 Frampton--Glashow--Yanagida（MMFGY）框架在包含两个右手中微子的最小 type-I seesaw 中的两种实现。两者都保留一个精确的 Yukawa 纹理零，并分别补充一个物理 CP 破坏相位或一个残余 CP 对称性。显式 CP 实现给出十二种高能 Yukawa 组态，它们约化为三个低能类别，并具有相关联的 CP 相位以及对无中微子双 beta 衰变的预言。在两种实现中，都可能出现一个被强烈压低的第二个 Yukawa 矩阵元，尽管在准简并区域中完整矩阵的层级仍保持中等。我们分析了非简并基准、准简并 TeV 标度右手中微子，以及更低质量情形下的 leptogenesis，其中相干产生、振荡和电弱 sphaleron 冻结变得重要。在所扫描的广泛基准范围内都能获得成功的 leptogenesis，并且在最低质量标度下对初始右手中微子丰度的敏感性增强。要求成功的 leptogenesis 会限制允许的相位，同时保留近似第二个零的可能性。两种实现表现出不同的近似零模式以及 leptogenesis 预言，表明对高能 Yukawa 结构的不同限制如何影响重子生成。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy of black holes from the first law of thermodynamics
papers.abstract: We compute the entanglement entropy of quantum matter in spacetimes with a Killing horizon entirely on-shell, by integrating the first law of thermodynamics along a one-parameter family of equilibrium backgrounds labelled by the Hawking temperature. This yields a closed expression in terms of the renormalized stress-energy tensor and the Killing vector, finite by construction, with no replicas and no conical singularities. Its covariant form agrees with the matter terms of the Bardeen--Carter--Hawking mass variation formula. We show in details that for static patch of de Sitter space and for the non-rotating BTZ black hole it reproduces the conical entropy exactly, contact term $Q$ included.
papers.title_cn: 从热力学第一定律出发的黑洞纠缠熵
papers.abs_cn: 我们完全在壳上计算了具有Killing视界的时空中量子物质的纠缠熵，方法是沿着一族由Hawking温度标记的单参数平衡背景对热力学第一定律进行积分。这给出了一个用重整化应力-能量张量和Killing矢量表示的闭式表达式，其构造上有限，无需复制品且无锥形奇点。其协变形式与Bardeen--Carter--Hawking质量变分公式中的物质项一致。我们详细证明，对于de Sitter空间的静态区域和非旋转BTZ黑洞，它精确再现了锥形熵，包括接触项$Q$。

papers.title: Optical absorption spectra from the $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter framework for thousands of atoms
papers.abstract: The frequency-dependent absorption and emission of light determine the colors of matter and underpin today's technologies, from solar cells to light-emitting diodes. Predicting optical properties from first principles remains a computational challenge, especially for large and disordered systems. The $GW$ plus Bethe-Salpeter equation ($GW$-BSE) approach provides predictive accuracy for optical properties, but conventional implementations become costly as system size grows. Here, we present a $GW$-BSE framework combining real-time propagation, atom-centered basis sets, and a locally optimized real-space resolution of the identity. The cost of each propagation step scales quadratically with system size and roughly equals the cost of one self-consistent-field iteration in a density-functional calculation with a semilocal functional. This computational efficiency allows us to calculate the absorption spectrum of a nanographene containing 4616 atoms and opens a path toward routine calculations of optical properties for large disordered systems.
papers.title_cn: 面向数千原子的 $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter 框架的光吸收谱
papers.abs_cn: 光的频率相关吸收和发射决定了物质的颜色，并支撑着当今从太阳能电池到发光二极管的各种技术。从第一性原理预测光学性质仍然是一个计算挑战，尤其是对于大型和无序体系。$GW$ 加 Bethe-Salpeter 方程（$GW$-BSE）方法为光学性质提供了可预测的精度，但传统实现随着体系尺寸增大而变得昂贵。在这里，我们提出了一个 $GW$-BSE 框架，结合了实时传播、原子中心基组以及局部优化的实空间单位分解。每个传播步骤的成本随体系尺寸呈二次方缩放，并且大致等于使用半局域泛函的密度泛函计算中一次自洽场迭代的成本。这种计算效率使我们能够计算包含 4616 个原子的纳米石墨烯的吸收谱，并为大型无序体系光学性质的常规计算开辟了道路。

papers.title: Beyond QAOA: A Review of AI and Quantum Computing for Adaptive Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract: Near-term quantum approaches to combinatorial optimization are limited by qubit counts, circuit fidelity, sampling cost, and the difficulty of encoding constraints, while machine learning is increasingly used to configure and control quantum optimization workflows. We call such workflows adaptive: decisions conventionally fixed in advance, from formulation and penalties to shot budgets, backends, and whether to invoke a quantum processor at all, are made by learned policies that respond to the instance, the progress of the solve, or the hardware. This review examines three paradigms, AI for quantum optimization, quantum for AI-driven optimization, and AI-quantum co-optimization, and organizes the literature by the decision being learned rather than by application. A structured review of 119 papers, 67 coded in detail, shows that the evidence is considerably stronger for AI-assisted quantum optimization than for the reverse direction: learning already reduces quantum evaluations, improves initialization, supports decomposition and penalty control, and mitigates noise, whereas evidence that quantum computation improves learned optimizers remains largely confined to small-scale simulation. Experimental controls are thin: 25 of 57 studies include no classical baseline, the quantum contribution is fully isolated in 10 of 24 studies where an ablation applies, and the median experiment uses 17 qubits. We introduce an M0-M5 evidence hierarchy, from simulation to matched-resource practical advantage, and find no broadly convincing result at the highest level. We argue that scaling is increasingly a systems problem: the question is not only whether a problem fits on a quantum processor, but how classical and quantum resources should be allocated across the optimization process. The review is aimed at researchers in quantum computing, machine learning, and operations research.
papers.title_cn: 超越 QAOA：面向自适应组合优化的 AI 与量子计算综述
papers.abs_cn: 近期量子方法在组合优化中受到量子比特数、电路保真度、采样成本以及约束编码难度的限制，而机器学习正越来越多地被用于配置和控制量子优化工作流。我们将这类工作流称为自适应的：从问题表述和惩罚项到采样预算、后端选择，乃至是否调用量子处理器，这些传统上预先固定的决策，如今由能够对问题实例、求解进展或硬件状态作出响应的学习策略来做出。本综述考察了三种范式——AI 用于量子优化、量子用于 AI 驱动的优化，以及 AI-量子协同优化——并按所学习的决策而非应用领域来组织文献。对 119 篇论文的结构化综述（其中 67 篇进行了详细编码）表明，AI 辅助量子优化的证据远比反方向更为充分：学习已经能够减少量子评估次数、改善初始化、支持分解与惩罚控制并缓解噪声，而量子计算改进学习型优化器的证据仍主要局限于小规模模拟。实验对照较为薄弱：57 项研究中有 25 项未包含经典基线，在 24 项适用消融的研究中仅有 10 项完全隔离了量子贡献，实验所用量子比特数的中位数为 17。我们提出了一个 M0-M5 证据层级，从模拟到资源匹配下的实际优势，并发现最高层级尚无广泛令人信服的结果。我们认为，规模化正日益成为一个系统问题：问题不仅在于某个问题能否放入量子处理器，还在于经典与量子资源应如何在优化过程中进行分配。本综述面向量子计算、机器学习和运筹学领域的研究者。

papers.title: A Coherent Harmonic Summing Pulsar Search Code
papers.abstract: Pulsars have narrow pulses, so their signals spread over many harmonics in a Fourier transform. Standard pulsar searches add the powers of those harmonics and discard their phases, which throws away the pulse shape and some of the signal. Folding the time series at each trial period keeps both, but is expensive even with the Fast Folding Algorithm (FFA). We describe CoherentSearch.jl, an open-source Julia code that reconstructs the pulse profile at every trial spin frequency directly from the Fourier transform. It interpolates the complex amplitudes of typically 60 harmonics, inverse transforms them into a profile, and tests that profile against boxcar templates of many widths. Because the input spectrum is normalized, the noise in every profile is known in closed form, so one threshold gives one false-alarm rate across the whole search. In an injection study of over 860,000 simulated pulsars at a matched false-alarm rate, the new search recovers 76% of the pulsars in white noise, against 64% for riptide's FFA in its recommended configuration and 42% for PRESTO's accelsearch, and its threshold does not move under red noise. On one CPU core it is 1.4-2.2 times faster than riptide at matched frequency coverage, it scales to 27 times faster on 48 cores, and modern GPUs run it up to nine times faster than a 20-core workstation.
papers.title_cn: 一个相干谐波求和脉冲星搜索代码
papers.abs_cn: 脉冲星的脉冲很窄，因此其信号在傅里叶变换中会扩展到许多谐波上。标准的脉冲星搜索会将那些谐波的功率相加并丢弃其相位，从而丢弃了脉冲形状和部分信号。在每个尝试周期上折叠时间序列可以同时保留两者，但即使使用快速折叠算法（FFA）也很昂贵。我们描述了 CoherentSearch.jl，一个开源的 Julia 代码，它直接从傅里叶变换中重建每个尝试自转频率处的脉冲轮廓。它插值通常 60 个谐波的复振幅，将它们逆变换为轮廓，并用多种宽度的矩形模板检验该轮廓。由于输入频谱已归一化，每个轮廓中的噪声具有闭式解，因此一个阈值即可在整个搜索中给出一个虚警率。在一项对超过 860,000 个模拟脉冲星的注入研究中，在匹配虚警率下，新搜索在白噪声中恢复了 76% 的脉冲星，而 riptide 的 FFA 在其推荐配置下为 64%，PRESTO 的 accelsearch 为 42%，并且其阈值在红噪声下不会移动。在单个 CPU 核心上，它在匹配频率覆盖下比 riptide 快 1.4-2.2 倍，在 48 个核心上可扩展到快 27 倍，而现代 GPU 运行它的速度比 20 核工作站快达九倍。

papers.title: Flavour decomposition of the nucleon tensor multipole moments
papers.abstract: We compute the chiral-odd form factors $H_T$, $E_T$ and $\hT$ of the nucleon in light-cone QCD sum rules, separately for the $u$ and $d$ quarks, and organise them into the tensor monopole, dipole and quadrupole moments $g_T$, $κ_T$ and $Q_T$. The quadrupole moment, with no chiral-even counterpart at leading twist, and the isoscalar channel, whose sum rules were derived but never evaluated, are new in this framework. The form factors are read from a Lorentz basis independent only after canonical ordering of the Dirac strings; three of the eight surviving structures give the three form factors separately, and the one usually used for the tensor charge is not among the eight. Two exact results follow analytically. The $d$-quark contributions to $E_T$ and $\hT$ are equal and opposite in the chiral limit, broken in proportion to the quark mass and the twist-six amplitude $\mathcal{V}_6$, so the $d$-quark sector carries a single independent function; and the isoscalar tensor charge receives no leading-twist contribution, its twist-three terms cancelling between the flavours. Neither is visible without resolving the flavours. At $μ^2=1$~GeV$^2$ the two distribution-amplitude sets give $g_T^{u-d}=1.27(7)$, $1.08(6)$, $κ_T^{u-d}=1.35(62)$, $1.58(59)$, $Q_T^{u-d}=-4.40(83)$, $-4.20(73)$ and $g_T^{u+d}=0.39(7)$, $0.38(6)$, $κ_T^{u+d}=4.47(62)$, $4.32(59)$, $Q_T^{u+d}=2.41(53)$, $1.56(30)$. The mean-field relation $2\hT^{u-d}=-E_T^{u-d}$, tested without any large-$N_c$ assumption, holds in sign and order of magnitude, with ratio $0.64(16)$ and $0.67(15)$ against the predicted unity. In the impact-parameter plane the moments displace the two flavour distributions in opposite transverse directions by nearly equal amounts, $\langle b_y\rangle=0.37$ and $-0.37$~fm, and elongate both across the polarisation axis, the $d$ quark some five to six times more strongly
papers.title_cn: 核子张量多极矩的味分解
papers.abs_cn: 我们在光锥 QCD 求和规则中计算了核子的手征奇形式因子 H_T、E_T 和 hT，分别针对 u 和 d 夸克，并将它们组织为张量单极矩、偶极矩和四极矩 g_T、κ_T 和 Q_T。四极矩在领头扭度没有手征偶对应物，而同位旋标量道虽然其求和规则已被推导但从未被计算，这两者在该框架中都是新的。形式因子从一个 Lorentz 基中读出，该基只有在 Dirac 弦正则排序后才独立；八个幸存结构中的三个分别给出三个形式因子，而通常用于张量荷的那个不在八个之中。两个精确结果可从解析上得到。在手征极限下，d 夸克对 E_T 和 hT 的贡献大小相等、符号相反，其破缺正比于夸克质量和扭度六振幅 mathcal{V}_6，因此 d 夸克部分只携带一个独立函数；而同位旋标量张量荷没有领头扭度贡献，其扭度三项在不同味之间相消。若不分辨味，这两者都不可见。在 μ^2=1 GeV^2 时，两组分布振幅给出 g_T^{u-d}=1.27(7)、1.08(6)，κ_T^{u-d}=1.35(62)、1.58(59)，Q_T^{u-d}=-4.40(83)、-4.20(73) 以及 g_T^{u+d}=0.39(7)、0.38(6)，κ_T^{u+d}=4.47(62)、4.32(59)，Q_T^{u+d}=2.41(53)、1.56(30)。平均场关系 2hT^{u-d}=-E_T^{u-d} 在没有任何大 N_c 假设的情况下被检验，在符号和数量级上成立，比值分别为 0.64(16) 和 0.67(15)，而预测值为 1。在碰撞参数平面中，这些矩将两种味的分布沿相反的横向方向移动几乎相等的量，⟨b_y⟩=0.37 和 -0.37 fm，并使两者沿极化轴方向拉长，其中 d 夸克的拉长程度约强五到六倍。

papers.title: Can end-to-end learning from raw electronic structure explain magnetic anisotropy?
papers.abstract: Machine-learning models trained directly on electronic spectra can predict spin--orbit-driven properties, yet models with comparable predictive accuracy may learn different electronic dependencies. We examine this problem using magnetic anisotropy in atomic-scale magnets and a validation strategy designed to assess the physical relevance of learned spectral relationships. We compare a bidirectional gated recurrent unit and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network, both trained to predict magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) from spin- and orbital-resolved scalar-relativistic densities of states (SR-DOS). Despite comparable in-domain (ID) accuracy, the architectures learn only partly overlapping spectral dependencies. Shapley additive explanations identify spectral features shared between the two architectures that can be associated with plausible spin--orbit-coupling pathways consistent with second-order perturbation theory (PT2). Adding PT2-derived MAE contributions to the model inputs has little effect on ID performance but can improve transfer beyond the training domain, with gains differing between architectures. Controlled spectral perturbations further demonstrate that similar attribution patterns do not imply the same functional dependence of the predicted MAE on spectral weight. The contrasting responses provide a functional context for architecture-dependent out-of-domain transfer. End-to-end learning can identify candidate electronic signatures of magnetic anisotropy. Their credible microscopic interpretation, however, rests on convergent evidence from predictive performance, model comparison, physical theory, controlled spectral interventions, and evaluation under distribution shift.
papers.title_cn: 从原始电子结构进行端到端学习能否解释磁各向异性？
papers.abs_cn: 直接在电子谱上训练的机器学习模型可以预测自旋-轨道驱动的性质，但预测精度相当的模型可能学到不同的电子依赖关系。我们利用原子尺度磁体中的磁各向异性以及一种旨在评估所学谱关系物理相关性的验证策略来研究这一问题。我们比较了双向门控循环单元和一维卷积神经网络，两者均被训练用于从自旋和轨道分辨的标量相对论态密度（SR-DOS）预测磁各向异性能（MAE）。尽管域内（ID）精度相当，这两种架构学到的谱依赖关系仅部分重叠。Shapley 加性解释识别出两种架构共享的谱特征，这些特征可与符合二阶微扰理论（PT2）的合理自旋-轨道耦合路径相关联。将 PT2 导出的 MAE 贡献添加到模型输入中对 ID 性能影响甚微，但可以改善向训练域之外的迁移，且增益因架构而异。受控谱扰动进一步表明，相似的归因模式并不意味着预测的 MAE 对谱权重具有相同的函数依赖关系。这些对比鲜明的响应为架构依赖的域外迁移提供了功能背景。端到端学习可以识别磁各向异性的候选电子特征。然而，其可信的微观解释依赖于来自预测性能、模型比较、物理理论、受控谱干预以及分布偏移下评估的收敛证据。

papers.title: A General Algorithm for Minimal Uncoupled Stress--Strain Calculations of Elastic Constant
papers.abstract: We have developed a general algorithm for constructing the minimum number of strain configurations required to extract second-order elastic constants from first-principles stress-strain calculations without algebraic coupling between the constants targeted for extraction. The method operates on the sparsity structure of the symmetry-reduced elastic stiffness matrix, represented by an auxiliary binary matrix, and generates admissible strain patterns algorithmically rather than prescribing separate strain sets for individual crystal symmetries. Each independent elastic constant is obtained from a single stress component, while additional stress relations generated by the same deformation provide internal consistency checks. Because the six-dimensional strain space contains only 2^6-1=63 non-empty strain patterns, the minimality of the resulting sets can be verified exactly for every elastic-symmetry type considered. The construction reproduces established high-efficiency strain sets in cases where they are minimal and yields improved sets for symmetry classes in which previously tabulated schemes require additional configurations. Because the formulation is based on stress-strain derivatives, it can also be readily extended to finite temperatures using consistently sampled ensemble-averaged thermodynamic stresses. Explicit strain sets are derived for all elastic-symmetry types spanning the 230 crystallographic space groups, and their accuracy and computational efficiency are benchmarked against established approaches.
papers.title_cn: 弹性常数最小解耦应力-应变计算的通用算法
papers.abs_cn: 我们开发了一种通用算法，用于构造从第一性原理应力-应变计算中提取二阶弹性常数所需的最少数量的应变构型，且目标提取常数之间不存在代数耦合。该方法基于对称约化弹性刚度矩阵的稀疏结构，由辅助二进制矩阵表示，并通过算法生成允许的应变模式，而非为各个晶体对称性分别规定应变集。每个独立弹性常数由单个应力分量获得，而同一变形产生的额外应力关系提供内部一致性检验。由于六维应变空间仅包含 2^6-1=63 个非空应变模式，因此对于所考虑的每种弹性对称类型，所得集合的最小性均可精确验证。该构造在已有高效应变集为最小的情况下复现了这些集合，并在先前表格化方案需要额外构型的对称类中给出了改进的集合。由于该表述基于应力-应变导数，它也可以利用一致采样的系综平均热力学应力，容易地扩展到有限温度。我们为涵盖 230 个晶体空间群的所有弹性对称类型导出了显式应变集，并将其精度和计算效率与已有方法进行了基准测试。

papers.title: Interlayer ferromagnetic order revealed through pressure-enhanced interlayer exchange coupling in Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Van der Waals ferromagnets possess finite interlayer magnetic coupling despite their layered crystal structures, and this coupling plays an important role in determining their magnetic properties. In this study, we performed magnetization measurements on high-quality Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ single crystals while selectively tuning the interlayer coupling using hydrostatic pressure. We identified two characteristic temperatures, $T_{\rm inf1}$ and $T_{\rm inf2}$, below the Curie temperature with opposite pressure dependences: $T_{\rm inf1}$ is associated with thermally activated domain-wall depinning, whereas $T_{\rm inf2}$ reflects the formation of interlayer ferromagnetic order. Both temperatures exhibit pronounced pressure dependences, in sharp contrast to the nearly pressure-independent Curie temperature associated with intralayer ferromagnetic order. First-principles calculations revealed a substantial pressure-induced enhancement of the interlayer exchange interaction and reasonably reproduced $T_{\rm inf2}$ and its pressure dependence. These results demonstrate that the emergence of interlayer magnetic ordering can be predicted from the microscopic interlayer exchange coupling, establishing a predictive framework for understanding and designing interlayer coupling phenomena in layered magnetic materials.
papers.title_cn: 通过压力增强的层间交换耦合揭示 Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ 中的层间铁磁序
papers.abs_cn: 范德华铁磁体尽管具有层状晶体结构，却仍存在有限的层间磁耦合，这种耦合在决定其磁性质方面起着重要作用。在本研究中，我们对高质量 Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ 单晶进行了磁化测量，同时利用静水压力选择性地调控层间耦合。我们在居里温度以下识别出两个特征温度 $T_{m inf1}$ 和 $T_{m inf2}$，它们具有相反的压力依赖性：$T_{m inf1}$ 与热激活的畴壁脱钉相关，而 $T_{m inf2}$ 则反映了层间铁磁序的形成。这两个温度都表现出显著的压力依赖性，这与几乎不依赖压力的、与层内铁磁序相关的居里温度形成鲜明对比。第一性原理计算揭示了压力诱导的层间交换相互作用显著增强，并合理地再现了 $T_{m inf2}$ 及其压力依赖性。这些结果表明，层间磁有序的出现可以从微观层间交换耦合中预测，从而为理解和设计层状磁性材料中的层间耦合现象建立了一个预测框架。

papers.title: Widespread steep X-ray spectra of luminous $z\simeq5.85-7.5$ quasars and their implications for future X-ray surveys
papers.abstract: Luminous quasars (QSOs) at the Epoch of Reionization (EoR, $z\gtrsim6$) host billion-solar-mass black holes assembled within the first Gyr of cosmic time. Their X-ray emission probes the innermost accreting regions and constrains the physical state of the corona during early supermassive black hole (SMBH) growth. Previous results from the HYPerluminous quasars at the Epoch of ReionizatION (HYPERION) sample of $z \gtrsim 6$ QSOs, powered by the most rapidly accreted SMBHs, suggested a link between X-ray spectral slope and long-term growth efficiency. We test whether the steep X-ray spectra of luminous z>6 QSOs are a general property of early SMBH growth or a peculiarity of the most efficiently grown SMBHs, using a sample extended mainly to the lowest growth efficiencies.
