We analysed the largest and most X-ray sensitive sample of 28 luminous QSOs at $z \simeq 5.85-7.56$ (26 used in the correlation analysis), combining HYPERION targets, luminous non-HYPERION sources, and QSOs powered by moderately accreting SMBHs newly observed in our XMM-Newton Large Programme. We re-derived black hole masses and growth indicators for the entire sample homogeneously, incorporating the latest JWST-based spectroscopic measurements to ensure the most consistent and high-quality characterization across all targets. We found no statistically significant correlation between coronal spectral parameters and BH growth indicators: luminous $z \gtrsim 6$ QSOs systematically show steep X-ray continua, with high photon indices and/or low high-energy cutoffs, consistent with cold coronae, possibly linked to rapid accretion. Finally, if steep X-ray slopes are common among early AGN, they may significantly reduce count rates, at fixed intrinsic luminosity, in future surveys of the EoR, affecting the detectability of steep-spectrum X-ray sources and thus the census of the early AGN population.
papers.title_cn: 高光度 z≃5.85-7.5 类星体普遍存在陡峭 X 射线谱及其对未来 X 射线巡天的启示
papers.abs_cn: 再电离纪元（EoR，z≳6）的高光度类星体（QSO）拥有在宇宙诞生后第一个十亿年内组装完成的十亿太阳质量黑洞。其 X 射线辐射探测最内区的吸积区域，并约束早期超大质量黑洞（SMBH）生长期间日冕的物理状态。此前来自再电离纪元超亮类星体（HYPERION）样本（z≳6 QSO）的结果——这些源由吸积最快速的 SMBH 驱动——表明 X 射线谱斜率与长期生长效率之间存在联系。我们检验高光度 z>6 QSO 的陡峭 X 射线谱是早期 SMBH 生长的普遍性质，还是生长效率最高的 SMBH 所特有的性质，所用样本主要扩展至生长效率最低的源。我们分析了 z≃5.85-7.56 的 28 个高光度 QSO 的最大且 X 射线最灵敏样本（其中 26 个用于相关性分析），结合了 HYPERION 目标、高光度非 HYPERION 源，以及由中等吸积 SMBH 驱动、在我们新的 XMM-Newton 大项目中新观测的 QSO。我们对整个样本均匀地重新推导了黑洞质量和生长指标，并纳入最新的基于 JWST 的光谱测量，以确保对所有目标进行最一致、最高质量的表征。我们发现日冕谱参数与 BH 生长指标之间没有统计显著的相关性：高光度 z≳6 QSO 系统性地表现出陡峭的 X 射线连续谱，具有高光子指数和/或低高能截断，与冷日冕一致，可能与快速吸积有关。最后，如果陡峭的 X 射线斜率在早期 AGN 中普遍存在，那么在固定本征光度下，它们可能显著降低未来 EoR 巡天中的计数率，影响陡谱 X 射线源的探测能力，从而影响早期 AGN 群体的普查。

papers.title: Electric and Heat Transport in One-Dimensional SNS Junctions with Energy-Dependent Transmission
papers.abstract: We investigate the phase-independent dc components of the electric and heat currents through a one-dimensional superconductor-normal-metal-superconductor (SNS) junction subject to chemical-potential and temperature differences between two superconducting reservoirs. Using a scattering approach based on the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations, we incorporate multiple Andreev reflections while retaining the energy dependence of transmission through the normal region. We compare energy-independent, quantum-dot-type, and quantum-point-contact transmission profiles. At low bias, both currents exhibit nonlinear features associated with the superconducting gap and multiple Andreev reflections. Their responses to a temperature difference depend remarkably on the transmission profile. At a small finite bias, the electric current depends weakly on the temperature difference for the energy-independent and quantum-dot-type profiles, whereas the quantum-point-contact profile produces a pronounced nonlinear response. The heat current depends nonlinearly on the temperature difference for all three profiles over the parameter range investigated. These results highlight the role of the transmission profile in nonlinear electric and heat transport through SNS junctions and provide a microscopic reference for related transport studies in mesoscopic fermionic superfluid junctions.
papers.title_cn: 具有能量依赖透射的一维SNS结中的电输运与热输运
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了一维超导体-正常金属-超导体（SNS）结中，当两个超导库之间存在化学势差和温度差时，电电流和热电流的相位无关直流分量。基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程的散射方法，我们在保留通过正常区透射的能量依赖性的同时，纳入了多重Andreev反射。我们比较了能量无关、量子点型和量子点接触型透射谱。在低偏压下，两种电流都表现出与超导能隙和多重Andreev反射相关的非线性特征。它们对温度差的响应显著依赖于透射谱。在小的有限偏压下，对于能量无关和量子点型透射谱，电电流对温度差的依赖较弱，而量子点接触型透射谱则产生显著的非线性响应。在所研究的参数范围内，对于所有三种透射谱，热电流都非线性地依赖于温度差。这些结果凸显了透射谱在通过SNS结的非线性电输运和热输运中的作用，并为介观费米子超流结中的相关输运研究提供了微观参考。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal black holes with primary hair in beyond Horndeski gravity: Exact solutions and stability
papers.abstract: We develop a novel systematic method for constructing exact, static, and asymptotically flat black-hole solutions in shift-symmetric and $Z_2$-symmetric beyond Horndeski theories. In contrast to previous studies, our approach does not rely on the restrictive reciprocal condition $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$, allowing for more general geometries characterized by two independent metric functions. The resulting solution space contains two qualitatively distinct types of hair originating from different branches of the theory. One branch is characterized by khronometric hair, while the other by genuine scalar hair. In both, the scalar profile defines a nontrivial preferred foliation, but the shift-symmetry Noether current and the associated propagating degree of freedom are trivial for the former and nonvanishing for the latter. Focusing mainly on the second branch, we derive several distinct families of exact black-hole solutions. In general, these solutions are singular and exhibit primary scalar hair associated with an independent scalar charge. Nevertheless, we demonstrate that they can be regularized to yield regular black-hole or solitonic configurations, for which the scalar hair becomes secondary. We further investigate the stability properties of these solutions under linear perturbations by analyzing the axial sector and the monopole $(\ell=0)$ mode of the even-parity sector. For representative solutions with scalar hair, the perturbative analysis provides evidence for linear stability under the modes considered.
papers.title_cn: 超越Horndeski引力中具有初级毛发的非互易黑洞：精确解与稳定性
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的系统性方法，用于在平移对称和$Z_2$对称的超越Horndeski理论中构造精确、静态且渐近平坦的黑洞解。与先前的研究不同，我们的方法不依赖于限制性的互易条件$g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$，从而允许由两个独立度规函数表征的更一般几何。由此得到的解空间包含两种性质不同的毛发类型，分别源自理论的不同分支。一个分支以khronometric毛发为特征，另一个分支则以真正的标量毛发为特征。在这两者中，标量剖面都定义了一个非平庸的偏好叶状结构，但平移对称Noether流及相关的传播自由度在前者中是平庸的，而在后者中非零。我们主要关注第二个分支，推导出若干不同的精确黑洞解族。一般而言，这些解是奇异的，并表现出与独立标量荷相关的初级标量毛发。尽管如此，我们证明它们可以被正则化，从而产生规则黑洞或孤子构型，此时标量毛发变为次级。我们进一步通过分析轴向扇区和偶宇称扇区的单极$(\ell=0)$模式，研究这些解在线性扰动下的稳定性。对于具有标量毛发的代表性解，微扰分析提供了在所考虑模式下线稳定性的证据。

papers.title: Parameter-Dependent Noise Resilience in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
papers.abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a variational quantum algorithm used for solving combinatorial optimization problems, which is thought to be a promising application of near-term quantum hardware. However, high rates of noise in these devices can obscure meaningful results. Therefore, it is crucial to understand and suppress the effects of noise on the algorithm's output. Here, we find that the stability of the algorithm in the presence of noise is dependent on its variational parameters. Using a Pauli noise model, we derive an upper bound on the total variation distance between the noisy and noiseless circuit output as a function of these parameters. Results from noisy simulations support this bound and give insight into the best methods to use for parameter generation in the presence of noise. We also introduce new methods of optimization using error penalties and truncated search based on this bound to manufacture error resilience. We extend this analysis to the quantum adiabatic algorithm (QAA) by taking the continuous limit of the QAOA.
papers.title_cn: 量子近似优化算法中依赖于参数的噪声鲁棒性
papers.abs_cn: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）是一种用于求解组合优化问题的变分量子算法，被认为是近期量子硬件的一个有前景的应用。然而，这些设备中的高噪声率可能会掩盖有意义的结果。因此，理解和抑制噪声对算法输出的影响至关重要。在这里，我们发现算法在噪声存在下的稳定性取决于其变分参数。使用泡利噪声模型，我们推导了噪声电路与无噪声电路输出之间总变分距离的上界，该上界是这些参数的函数。噪声模拟的结果支持了这一上界，并为在噪声存在下生成参数的最佳方法提供了见解。我们还基于这一上界引入了使用误差惩罚和截断搜索的新优化方法，以制造抗误差能力。通过取 QAOA 的连续极限，我们将这一分析扩展到量子绝热算法（QAA）。

papers.title: Predicting plasmonic pole representations of complex dielectric spectra using convolutional neural networks
papers.abstract: Extracting spectral properties such as energy position, broadening, and spectral weight from dielectric spectra is critical for interpreting collective electronic excitations in many-body physics. Conventional approaches typically rely on nonlinear fitting procedures that can be computationally demanding and highly sensitive to initialization and fitting choices. In this work, we develop a convolutional neural-network framework for the direct inversion of dielectric spectra into their underlying plasmonic pole structures using a multipole-Padé representation. Rather than training on a constrained database of spectra associated with a specific set of materials, the network is trained entirely on synthetic spectra generated from the analytical multipole-Padé expression with randomized parameters. This enables the network to learn the general mapping between the spectra and their features in an unbiased way, without requiring large, material-specific datasets derived from real materials. We demonstrate that the synthetically trained network generalizes to complex first-principles and experimental dielectric spectra, extracting the underlying pole parameters with high accuracy in a single forward pass. This approach provides an efficient and robust alternative to conventional nonlinear fitting, enabling high-throughput, automated analysis of dielectric spectra across diverse materials and applications.
papers.title_cn: 使用卷积神经网络预测复杂介电谱的等离激元极点表示
papers.abs_cn: 从介电谱中提取能量位置、展宽和谱权重等谱特性对于解释多体物理中的集体电子激发至关重要。传统方法通常依赖于非线性拟合过程，这类方法计算量大，且对初始化和拟合选择高度敏感。在本工作中，我们开发了一个卷积神经网络框架，利用多极点-Padé表示将介电谱直接反演为其潜在的等离激元极点结构。该网络并非在特定材料集相关的受限谱数据库上训练，而是完全在由随机参数的多极点-Padé解析表达式生成的合成谱上进行训练。这使得网络能够以无偏的方式学习谱与其特征之间的一般映射关系，而无需来自真实材料的大型材料特定数据集。我们证明，经过合成训练的网络能够泛化到复杂的第一性原理和实验介电谱，在单次前向传播中高精度地提取潜在的极点参数。该方法为传统非线性拟合提供了一种高效且稳健的替代方案，使得跨多种材料和应用的介电谱高通量自动化分析成为可能。

papers.title: Mode-selective electron-phonon coupling drives charge density waves in the kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$
papers.abstract: YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ host the highest charge density wave (CDW) transition temperatures ever reported in kagome metals, $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx 800$ and 400~K, with propagation vectors $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx(1/2,0,0)$ and $(1/4,0,0)$, respectively. The microscopic mechanism behind these record values has remained unresolved. Here, we combine anharmonic phonon renormalization extracted from molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned force field with mode-resolved electron-phonon coupling (EPC) analysis to identify this mechanism. The CDW is driven by mode-selective EPC: the Ru out-of-plane phonon modes couple the Ru-$d_{xz}/d_{yz}$ and Si-$p_x/p_y$ orbitals, and the phonon linewidth peaks sharply at $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$, while the featureless electronic susceptibility rules out Fermi-surface nesting. Phonon anharmonicity melts the CDW, and the anharmonic phonon spectra reproduce both $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ and $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ in good agreement with experiments. Molecular dynamics simulations also visualize the CDW melting in real space. Chemical bonding analysis further shows that the smaller Y$^{3+}$ radius strengthens the Ru-Ru bonds, enhancing lattice rigidity and accounting for the factor-of-two higher $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ of YRu$_3$Si$_2$. Our results establish a unified microscopic picture of CDW formation and melting in kagome metals YRu$_3$Si$_2$ and LaRu$_3$Si$_2$.
papers.title_cn: 模式选择性电子-声子耦合驱动笼目金属 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 中的电荷密度波
papers.abs_cn: YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 具有笼目金属中迄今报道的最高电荷密度波（CDW）转变温度，$T_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx 800$ 和 400~K，其传播矢量分别为 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}\approx(1/2,0,0)$ 和 $(1/4,0,0)$。这些创纪录数值背后的微观机制一直未得到解决。在此，我们将由机器学习力场驱动的分子动力学所提取的非谐声子重整化与模式分辨的电子-声子耦合（EPC）分析相结合，以确定这一机制。CDW 由模式选择性 EPC 驱动：Ru 面外声子模式耦合 Ru-$d_{xz}/d_{yz}$ 和 Si-$p_x/p_y$ 轨道，声子线宽在 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 处急剧达到峰值，而无特征的电子磁化率排除了费米面嵌套。声子非谐性熔化 CDW，非谐声子谱再现了 $Q_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 和 $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$，与实验吻合良好。分子动力学模拟还在实空间中可视化了 CDW 的熔化。化学键分析进一步表明，较小的 Y$^{3+}$ 半径增强了 Ru-Ru 键，提高了晶格刚性，并解释了 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 的 $T_{\mathrm{CDW}}$ 高出两倍的原因。我们的结果建立了笼目金属 YRu$_3$Si$_2$ 和 LaRu$_3$Si$_2$ 中 CDW 形成与熔化的统一微观图像。

papers.title: Non-Perturbative Vibrational Excitation by Arbitrary Electric Fields from Classical Phase-Space Dynamics
papers.abstract: We present a non-perturbative framework for the quantum treatment of vibrational excitation in molecular systems driven by electric fields with arbitrary time dependence. For harmonic potentials with linear dipole coupling, the field-induced dynamics is exactly described by a displaced coherent state, whose evolution is completely determined by a complex phase-space coordinate. Closed-form expressions for this coordinate reveal a clear distinction between resonant and non-resonant regimes. The resulting vibrational populations follow a Poisson distribution determined by a dimensionless time-dependent phase-space displacement, for both resonant and non-resonant driving. Resonant driving results in an enhanced phase-space displacement, whereas finite detuning between the driving and vibrational frequencies leads to an exponential suppression of the phase-space displacement and vibrational excitation. While the approach reduces to the standard time-dependent perturbation theory in the weak-field limit, it remains valid in the strong-field regime, where perturbative treatments fail. Our results provide a transparent phase-space picture of vibrational control and enable non-perturbative state preparation in ultrafast spectroscopy.
papers.title_cn: 基于经典相空间动力学的任意电场非微扰振动激发
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一个非微扰框架，用于量子处理由任意时间依赖电场驱动的分子系统中的振动激发。对于具有线性偶极耦合的谐振子势，场诱导动力学可由一个位移相干态精确描述，其演化完全由一个复相空间坐标决定。该坐标的闭式表达式揭示了共振区与非共振区之间的清晰区别。对于共振和非共振驱动，所得的振动布居数均遵循由无量纲时间依赖相空间位移决定的泊松分布。共振驱动导致增强的相空间位移，而驱动频率与振动频率之间的有限失谐则导致相空间位移和振动激发的指数抑制。虽然该方法在弱场极限下退化为标准的时间依赖微扰理论，但它在微扰处理失效的强场区域仍然有效。我们的结果为振动控制提供了一个透明的相空间图像，并使得超快光谱中的非微扰态制备成为可能。

papers.title: Robust skyrmion nucleation and transport via composition gradient in rare earth-transition metal ferrimagnets
papers.abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are typically nucleated via localized excitation methods, such as laser heating, spin-orbit torques, or engineered defects, and their controlled transport is often limited by the skyrmion Hall effect. Here, we demonstrate that spatial gradients in rare-earth--transition-metal alloys, achievable through patterned laser writing, enable both deterministic nucleation and controlled transport. The strategy leverages engineered compositional gradient to cross the magnetization compensation point, defining regions with opposite magnetization. An out-of-plane magnetic field selectively reverses the magnetization, generating a skyrmion. Crucially, the same compositional design enables a channel tuned to the spin angular momentum compensation point, where skyrmions are driven by spin-orbit torques at high velocity with vanishing skyrmion Hall effect. Local composition variations act as pinning sites, enabling threshold-controlled trapping and release.
papers.title_cn: 稀土-过渡金属亚铁磁体中通过成分梯度实现稳健的斯格明子成核与输运
papers.abs_cn: 磁性斯格明子通常通过局域激发方法成核，例如激光加热、自旋轨道矩或人工缺陷，而其受控输运往往受到斯格明子霍尔效应的限制。在此，我们证明稀土-过渡金属合金中的空间梯度——可通过图案化激光写入实现——能够同时实现确定性成核和受控输运。该策略利用工程化成分梯度穿越磁化补偿点，定义出具有相反磁化的区域。面外磁场选择性地反转磁化，从而产生斯格明子。关键在于，相同的成分设计能够实现一个调谐至自旋角动量补偿点的通道，在该通道中斯格明子由自旋轨道矩以高速度驱动，且斯格明子霍尔效应消失。局部成分变化充当钉扎位点，从而实现阈值控制的捕获与释放。

papers.title: Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains
papers.abstract: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/λ$, where $λ\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/λ)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $Σ_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $Σ_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.
papers.title_cn: 极端黑洞模拟体：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号序列
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出一个时空，它可作为极端黑洞的无视界模拟体。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模拟体不同——其几何为虫洞型，由两个渐近平坦区域通过极长喉部连接——极端黑洞的模拟体一端具有单个渐近平坦区域，另一端为无限长喉部。在喉部区域，时空趋近于直积几何 M_{1,1} × S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 是二维 Minkowski 时空，S^2 是二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉部的局部分析中会出现类 Aretakis 模式，但它们不会导致模拟体的物理不稳定性。最初局域在喉部的标量扰动在晚期会产生一系列信号，其特征间隔为 t_delay ~ 1/λ，其中 λ << 1 是形变参数。该时间尺度在参数上大于非极端黑洞模拟体所特有的回声时间 t_echo ~ ln(1/λ)。我们将这一序列称为长延迟信号序列。从几何上看，长延迟信号的周期性对应于 S^2 上的周期测地线。随后我们将该构造推广到极端 Kerr。在这种情况下，喉部区域趋近于一个涉及 M_{1,1} 和二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应的信号预计会形成准周期信号序列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了向非极端黑洞虫洞模拟体的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下对幺正性的意义。

papers.title: Convergence of Roberts flow dynamos in Eulerian and Lagrangian codes
papers.abstract: Standard benchmark tests for numerical magnetohydrodynamics codes focus on one- and two-dimensional problems that ignore the possibility of dynamos, i.e., an exponential instability converting kinetic energy into magnetic energy. They also tend to ignore magnetic helicity conservation that can have dramatic effects in periodic domains. The existence of magnetic diffusion is crucial for dynamos, as was exemplified by the impossibility of finding dynamo solutions when using Euler potentials, which is a perfectly valid approach in the absence of magnetic diffusion. The Roberts flows~I, II, III, and IV are two-dimensional flows that support three-dimensional dynamos, all of which are also large-scale dynamos in the sense that their planar averages are of significant strengths, even though flow~II is pointwise non-helical. Here we demonstrate the numerical convergence properties of solutions obtained using discretisation schemes of second, sixth, and tenth order in the mesh width in the Pencil Code, compare the results with the SPH-based SWIFT code, and present a list of averaged quantities that facilitate their use in characterising the solutions as benchmarks. In addition, we present a procedure to obtain two-dimensional time-independent magnetic field visualisation for all Roberts flows, and perform per-pixel comparison between the Pencil and SWIFT codes. The rich combination of features makes Roberts flows an excellent dynamo benchmark for the direct numerical simulations of magnetohydrodynamics equations.
papers.title_cn: 在欧拉和拉格朗日代码中 Roberts 流发电机的收敛性
papers.abs_cn: 数值磁流体力学代码的标准基准测试主要集中于一维和二维问题，忽略了发电机效应的可能性，即一种将动能转化为磁能的指数不稳定性。这些测试也往往忽略磁螺旋度守恒，而后者在周期域中可能产生显著影响。磁扩散的存在对发电机至关重要，正如使用欧拉势时无法找到发电机解所例证的那样，而在没有磁扩散的情况下，欧拉势是一种完全有效的方法。Roberts 流 I、II、III 和 IV 是支持三维发电机的二维流，所有这些也都是大尺度发电机，即其平面平均具有显著强度，尽管流 II 在逐点上是非螺旋的。在此，我们展示了在 Pencil Code 中使用网格宽度的二阶、六阶和十阶离散化方案获得的解的数值收敛性质，将结果与基于 SPH 的 SWIFT 代码进行比较，并提供了一系列平均量，以便在表征解时作为基准使用。此外，我们提出了一种方法，用于获得所有 Roberts 流的二维时间无关磁场可视化，并在 Pencil 和 SWIFT 代码之间进行逐像素比较。这些丰富的特性组合使 Roberts 流成为磁流体力学方程直接数值模拟的绝佳发电机基准。

papers.title: Error-Corrected Memory and Logic on a Heavy-Hex Superconducting-Qubit Processor
papers.abstract: Large quantum computations require high-fidelity error-corrected memory and fault-tolerant logical operations. To achieve these with superconducting circuits, quantum processors will need many components operating with low error rates. In practice, fabrication of monolithic superconducting devices produces unavoidable heterogeneity in component performance, which the quantum computer must accommodate. We implement strategies to operate a large dynamic compass code on an array of 156 superconducting qubits arranged on a heavy-hexagonal lattice, making use of the entire monolithic quantum processor and redesigning our measurement schedule to exclude underperforming components. We demonstrate improvements of up to $35\%$ in logical error probabilities for a memory experiment by using a noise-informed decoder combined with strategies to exclude the worst-performing qubits and couplers, along with post-selecting on shots with a low probability of leakage errors. In addition to these memory results, we also observe performance gains of up to $56\%$ when these strategies are applied to measurement-based logic, demonstrated by stability experiments. We furthermore demonstrate high-fidelity fault-tolerant logic through lattice surgery. Through pre-selection filtering techniques, we can obtain Bell fidelities above $77\%$, and further logical gap post-selection using exclusive decoding increases these fidelities to above $97\%$. Our experiments demonstrate that high performance can be maintained in key elements of fault-tolerant quantum memory and logic when working on monolithic superconducting quantum processors with underperforming components, by using a suite of noise-informed quantum error correction strategies.
papers.title_cn: 重六边形超导量子比特处理器上的纠错存储与逻辑
papers.abs_cn: 大规模量子计算需要高保真度的纠错存储和容错逻辑操作。为了在超导电路中实现这些目标，量子处理器需要大量以低错误率运行的组件。在实践中，单片超导器件的制造会在组件性能上产生不可避免的异质性，量子计算机必须适应这种情况。我们实施了在排列于重六边形晶格上的156个超导量子比特阵列上运行大型动态罗盘码的策略，利用了整个单片量子处理器，并重新设计了测量调度以排除性能不佳的组件。我们通过使用噪声感知解码器，结合排除表现最差的量子比特和耦合器的策略，以及对泄漏错误概率较低的采样进行后选择，在存储实验中展示了逻辑错误概率最高达35%的改进。除了这些存储结果之外，我们还将这些策略应用于基于测量的逻辑，通过稳定性实验展示了最高达56%的性能提升。我们进一步通过晶格手术展示了高保真度的容错逻辑。通过预选择滤波技术，我们可以获得高于77%的Bell保真度，而进一步使用排他解码进行逻辑间隙后选择将这些保真度提高到97%以上。我们的实验表明，通过使用一套噪声感知的量子纠错策略，在具有性能不佳组件的单片超导量子处理器上工作时，可以在容错量子存储和逻辑的关键要素中保持高性能。

papers.title: Epitaxial growth of WO3 on r-plane sapphire by hot-filament metal-oxide deposition using CO2 as a precursor
papers.abstract: The deposition of epitaxial films of WO3 by hot-filament metal-oxide deposition using CO2 as a precursor was demonstrated. The films were obtained at a low growth rate of 0.25 nm/min. The optical properties of the film were assessed by variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry, indicating transparency across the visible spectrum and high absorption above 3 eV.
papers.title_cn: 以 CO2 为前驱体通过热丝金属氧化物沉积在 r 面蓝宝石上外延生长 WO3
papers.abs_cn: 本文展示了以 CO2 为前驱体，通过热丝金属氧化物沉积法沉积 WO3 外延薄膜。薄膜以 0.25 nm/min 的低生长速率获得。通过可变角光谱椭偏仪评估了薄膜的光学性质，结果表明其在可见光范围内透明，并在高于 3 eV 时具有高吸收。

papers.title: From Solid-State Spin Defects to Fluorescent Proteins: A Perspective on Quantum Optical Sensing Platforms for Biomedical Applications
papers.abstract: Quantum optical sensing has evolved from isolated solid state spin defect platforms to increasingly bio-integrated systems designed for biomedical applications. This review presents a perspective on this transition, spanning nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond to emerging fluorescent protein based spin qubits. Advances in diamond fabrication have enabled photonic cavities, nanomechanical resonators, and microstructured devices that enhance spin photon interactions and room temperature sensitivity. Exploration of spin defects in alternative materials further expands the sensing landscape. Parallel progress toward biological compatibility includes chip based architectures for in vitro and in vivo studies, microfluidic integration, and minimally invasive nanodiamond probes capable of intracellular nanothermometry and nanorheometry. Improvements in surface functionalization have enhanced coherence and sensing reliability in complex environments. Collectively, these advances highlight the progress and remaining challenges toward application oriented quantum sensing for the life sciences.
papers.title_cn: 从固态自旋缺陷到荧光蛋白：面向生物医学应用的量子光学传感平台展望
papers.abs_cn: 量子光学传感已从孤立的固态自旋缺陷平台发展为日益生物集成的系统，专为生物医学应用而设计。本综述对这一转变进行了展望，涵盖从金刚石中的氮空位中心到新兴的基于荧光蛋白的自旋量子比特。金刚石制备技术的进步使得光子腔、纳米机械谐振器和微结构器件成为可能，这些器件增强了自旋-光子相互作用和室温灵敏度。对替代材料中自旋缺陷的探索进一步拓展了传感领域。在生物兼容性方面的并行进展包括用于体外和体内研究的芯片架构、微流控集成，以及能够实现细胞内纳米测温和纳米流变学的微创纳米金刚石探针。表面功能化的改进增强了复杂环境中的相干性和传感可靠性。总体而言，这些进展凸显了面向生命科学应用的量子传感所取得的进步和仍面临的挑战。

papers.title: The role of density in shaping electron trapping in amorphous silicon nitride
papers.abstract: The electronic properties of amorphous silicon nitride vary with processing, which often changes stoichiometry and density together. Separating their contributions is essential to connect film structure with electron trapping. Across 499 stoichiometric configurations spanning 2.86-3.19g cm$^{-3}$, porosity controls the trapping mixture. Lower density increases accessible void fraction from 8.4 to 12.6%, expands internal surface and more than triples the supply of free three-coordinate Si precursors. Capture at pre-existing Si dangling bonds (K centres) rises from 9 to 29%, while induced-K and polaronic trapping decline. A neutral precursor fingerprint predicts the trapping mixture in held-out configurations and reproduces its density dependence. Local compensation controls K-centre activation, electronic competition selects capture, and bond strain predicts polaronic relaxation or induced-K formation. Routes involve distinct network volumes but retain their characteristic depths and relaxation energies across the density range. At fixed stoichiometry, density controls the trapping mixture through porosity and precursor availability.
papers.title_cn: 密度在非晶氮化硅中塑造电子俘获的作用
papers.abs_cn: 非晶氮化硅的电子性质随工艺变化，而工艺往往同时改变化学计量比和密度。将二者的贡献分离对于将薄膜结构与电子俘获联系起来至关重要。在跨越 2.86-3.19g cm$^{-3}$ 的 499 种化学计量构型中，孔隙率控制着俘获混合。较低密度使可及空隙分数从 8.4% 增加到 12.6%，扩大内表面，并使自由三配位 Si 前驱体的供给增加三倍以上。在预先存在的 Si 悬挂键（K 中心）处的俘获从 9% 上升到 29%，而诱导-K 和极化子俘获下降。一种中性前驱体指纹可预测留出构型中的俘获混合，并再现其密度依赖性。局部补偿控制 K 中心激活，电子竞争选择俘获，键应变预测极化子弛豫或诱导-K 形成。路径涉及不同的网络体积，但在整个密度范围内保持其特征深度和弛豫能。在固定化学计量比下，密度通过孔隙率和前驱体可用性控制俘获混合。

papers.title: Dielectric constant of holographic insulator from quantum geometry
papers.abstract: We study dielectric properties of holographic insulators from the quantum geometry of the ground state. We realize the insulating state by the pseudoscalar interaction of holographic fermions and calculate the fermionic Green function to extract the effective hamiltonian. We then derive the quantum metric and Berry curvature to compute the transports and finally get the dielectric constant from the imaginary part of conductivity.
papers.title_cn: 全息绝缘体的介电常数：来自量子几何
papers.abs_cn: 我们从基态的量子几何研究全息绝缘体的介电性质。我们通过全息费米子的赝标量相互作用实现绝缘态，并计算费米子格林函数以提取有效哈密顿量。然后我们推导量子度规和 Berry 曲率来计算输运，最后从电导率的虚部得到介电常数。

papers.title: Probing $L_z$ Orbital Angular Momentum via Wavefunction-Interference-Induced Charge Order
papers.abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) characterization is central to understanding quantum materials such as valley Hall and Rashba systems and, through its connection to Berry curvature, provides key insight into band topology. Conventional OAM detection via photoemission dichroism, however, is susceptible to interference artifacts and is largely restricted to occupied states. Here, we demonstrate a real-space approach to map the $L_z$ OAM character using scanning tunneling microscopy in triangular atomic monolayers. Unlike photoemission, this method exploits interference effects arising from the $L_z$ orbital phase and the Bloch phase associated with neighboring atoms. This shifts the local density of states (LDOS) maxima to distinct Wyckoff positions between atoms, encoding $L_z$ information into characteristic real-space LDOS patterns. We exemplify this approach in 2D quantum materials with contrasting $L_z$ sequences, namely Tl/Si(111) and In/SiC(0001) monolayers, identifying $L_z$-dependent LDOS accumulation associated with distinct topological phases in both systems. Our results establish $L_z$-dependent charge localization as a proxy to atomic obstruction for energetically isolated states in triangular lattices, including transition-metal dichalcogenides.
papers.title_cn: 通过波函数干涉诱导的电荷序探测 $L_z$ 轨道角动量
papers.abs_cn: 轨道角动量（OAM）表征是理解谷霍尔和Rashba等量子材料的核心，并且通过其与Berry曲率的联系，为能带拓扑提供了关键洞察。然而，传统通过光电子二色性探测OAM的方法易受干涉伪影影响，且主要局限于占据态。在此，我们展示了一种在三角原子单层中利用扫描隧道显微镜映射$L_z$ OAM特征的实空间方法。与光电子发射不同，该方法利用了由$L_z$轨道相位和相邻原子的Bloch相位产生的干涉效应。这将局域态密度（LDOS）极大值移动到原子之间不同的Wyckoff位置，将$L_z$信息编码为特征性的实空间LDOS图案。我们在具有对比$L_z$序列的二维量子材料中例证了这种方法，即Tl/Si(111)和In/SiC(0001)单层，识别出与两个系统中不同拓扑相相关的$L_z$依赖的LDOS积累。我们的结果确立了$L_z$依赖的电荷局域化作为三角晶格中能量孤立态（包括过渡金属二硫属化物）原子阻碍的代理。

papers.title: Spin-outcome correlations and memory-assisted entropic uncertainty in Bhabha scattering with an entangled spectator
papers.abstract: We investigate spin-outcome correlations and memory-assisted entropic uncertainty in tree-level Bhabha scattering, where an incident electron $A$ scatters with a positron $B$ initially entangled with a spectator electron $C$. For the fixed-angle post-selected final state, we compare the total memory-assisted uncertainty $U_A$ for three alternative Pauli measurements on $A$ with the entanglement entropy $S(ρ_A)$ across the $A|BC$ partition. We resolve $U_A$ into the separate uncertainties $U_B$ and $U_C$ and evaluate the corresponding outcome-memory mutual-information sums $G_B$ and $G_C$. This separates changes in the randomness of the outcomes on $A$ from changes in their correlations with each memory. In the parameter regions studied, enhanced $A|BC$ entanglement is accompanied by lower $U_A$, most prominently near high-energy backscattering. An analytic treatment of this limit shows that $B$ factorizes from $AC$: $G_B$ vanishes, whereas $G_C$ increases with the initial $B$-$C$ entanglement. An entropic complete complementarity analysis characterizes the accompanying loss of local helicity predictability in $ρ_A$ and changes in the coherence, predictability, and mixedness of the interacting pair $ρ_{AB}$. These results show that initial $B$-$C$ entanglement can lower the total memory-assisted uncertainty in high-energy backscattering by strengthening spin-outcome correlations with the spectator $C$, thereby identifying the distinct roles of the interacting particle and the spectator as quantum memories.
papers.title_cn: 具有纠缠旁观者的Bhabha散射中的自旋-结果关联与记忆辅助熵不确定度
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了树级Bhabha散射中的自旋-结果关联与记忆辅助熵不确定度，其中入射电子 $A$ 与一个初始与旁观电子 $C$ 纠缠的正电子 $B$ 发生散射。对于固定角度后选择的末态，我们比较了在 $A$ 上进行三种替代Pauli测量时的总记忆辅助不确定度 $U_A$ 与 $A|BC$ 划分下的纠缠熵 $S(ρ_A)$。我们将 $U_A$ 分解为单独的不确定度 $U_B$ 和 $U_C$，并评估相应的结果-记忆互信息和 $G_B$ 与 $G_C$。这将 $A$ 上结果随机性的变化与其同各记忆之间关联的变化分离开来。在所研究的参数区域内，增强的 $A|BC$ 纠缠伴随着较低的 $U_A$，最显著的是在高能背散射附近。对该极限的解析处理表明，$B$ 从 $AC$ 中因子化：$G_B$ 消失，而 $G_C$ 随初始 $B$-$C$ 纠缠的增加而增加。熵完备互补性分析刻画了 $ρ_A$ 中局部螺旋度可预测性的伴随损失，以及相互作用对 $ρ_{AB}$ 的相干性、可预测性和混合度的变化。这些结果表明，初始 $B$-$C$ 纠缠可以通过加强与旁观者 $C$ 的自旋-结果关联，降低高能背散射中的总记忆辅助不确定度，从而识别出相互作用粒子与旁观者作为量子记忆的不同角色。

papers.title: No Particle Production and Integrability in AdS$_2$
papers.abstract: We propose an analogue of the no particle production condition in two-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, and demonstrate how this criterion uniquely reconstructs the curved-space Liouville and Toda theories via general-multiplicity holographic correlators.
papers.title_cn: AdS$_2$ 中的无粒子产生与可积性
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了二维反德西特空间中无粒子产生条件的一个类比，并展示了该判据如何通过一般多重性的全息关联函数唯一地重构弯曲空间 Liouville 和 Toda 理论。

papers.title: Holographic dark energy from generalized entropies and extended infrared cut-offs
papers.abstract: We study holographic dark energy models constructed from generalized entropy functionals and local infrared cut-offs. Three entropies (Barrow and the three and five-parameter generalized entropies) are each combined with the Granda-Oliveros (GO) cut-off and two extensions, one adding a $γH^{-2}$ term and one a $γ\ddot{H}/H$ term, the latter raising the dark-energy evolution equation to second order. The nine resulting models are constrained against DESI DR2 BAO, Pantheon+ and a Planck compressed CMB likelihood through an MCMC analysis, and compared using the Akaike and Bayesian information criteria. The Hubble constant is stable across all models. The $H^{-2}$ term is unconstrained in every case, as it becomes relevant only in the far future, and never improves on the GO cut-off. The $\ddot{H}/H$ term, instead, is tightly constrained for Barrow and $S_5$, where it improves the fit substantially, but not for $S_3$. The best fit is obtained for Barrow entropy with the $\ddot{H}/H$ cut-off, yet the Barrow exponent remains compatible with zero in all cases. The data thus favour a higher-order infrared cut-off, while showing no significant evidence for a departure from the Bekenstein-Hawking area law. We also investigate the dark energy equation of state (EoS) of $S_3$ and $S_5$, discovering quintessence-like behavior and phantom crossing.
papers.title_cn: 来自广义熵和扩展红外截断的全息暗能量
papers.abs_cn: 我们研究了由广义熵泛函和局部红外截断构建的全息暗能量模型。三种熵（Barrow 熵以及三参数和五参数广义熵）分别与 Granda-Oliveros (GO) 截断以及两种扩展相结合，一种添加了 $γH^{-2}$ 项，另一种添加了 $γ\ddot{H}/H$ 项，后者将暗能量演化方程提升为二阶。通过 MCMC 分析，将得到的九个模型与 DESI DR2 BAO、Pantheon+ 以及 Planck 压缩 CMB 似然进行约束，并使用 Akaike 和 Bayesian 信息准则进行比较。哈勃常数在所有模型中都是稳定的。$H^{-2}$ 项在所有情况下都未受约束，因为它仅在遥远的未来才变得重要，并且从未优于 GO 截断。相反，$\ddot{H}/H$ 项对于 Barrow 和 $S_5$ 受到严格约束，在这些情况下它显著改善了拟合，但对于 $S_3$ 则不然。最佳拟合是在带有 $\ddot{H}/H$ 截断的 Barrow 熵下获得的，然而 Barrow 指数在所有情况下都与零兼容。因此，数据倾向于更高阶的红外截断，同时没有显示出偏离 Bekenstein-Hawking 面积律的显著证据。我们还研究了 $S_3$ 和 $S_5$ 的暗能量状态方程 (EoS)，发现了类精质行为和 phantom 穿越。

papers.title: Remote nonreciprocal magnon magnon entanglement via the Barnett effect with coherent feedback
papers.abstract: We propose a scheme for generating and controlling remote nonreciprocal magnon--magnon entanglement in a cavity magnonic system with coherent feedback.The two microwave cavities are driven by independent single-mode squeezed vacuum fields, with a rotating YIG sphere in the left cavity and a stationary one in the right cavity. For a fixed rotation direction, reversing the bias magnetic field applied to the rotating sphere changes the sign of the Barnett shift, leading to nonreciprocal magnon--magnon entanglement. By tuning the cavity detuning and feedback phase, entanglement can be generated for one direction of the bias magnetic field while it vanishes for the opposite direction, yielding complete nonreciprocity. Coherent feedback enhances the entanglement at an appropriate reflectivity, whereas stronger feedback can reduce it. The relative squeezing phase provides additional control, and an appropriate choice of unequal squeezing factors improves the entanglement at fixed total input photon occupation. With the squeezed inputs kept fixed, moderate feedback also increases the critical temperature for magnon entanglement.Our results provide a controllable approach to preparing remote nonreciprocal quantum correlations in cavity magnonic systems.
papers.title_cn: 通过Barnett效应与相干反馈实现远程非互易磁振子-磁振子纠缠
papers.abs_cn: 我们提出了一种在具有相干反馈的腔磁振子系统中生成和控制远程非互易磁振子-磁振子纠缠的方案。两个微波腔由独立的单模压缩真空场驱动，左腔中有一个旋转的YIG球，右腔中有一个静止的YIG球。对于固定的旋转方向，反转施加于旋转球上的偏置磁场会改变Barnett位移的符号，从而导致非互易的磁振子-磁振子纠缠。通过调节腔失谐和反馈相位，可以在偏置磁场的一个方向上产生纠缠，而在相反方向上纠缠消失，从而实现完全非互易性。相干反馈在适当的反射率下增强纠缠，而更强的反馈则会降低纠缠。相对压缩相位提供了额外的控制，在固定总输入光子占据数的情况下，适当选择不相等的压缩因子可以改善纠缠。在压缩输入保持固定的情况下，适度的反馈也会提高磁振子纠缠的临界温度。我们的结果为在腔磁振子系统中制备远程非互易量子关联提供了一种可控的方法。

papers.title: Radio Continuum Study of One of the Brightest Large Magellanic Cloud Supernova Remnants N 132D
papers.abstract: We present a new radio continuum study of the Large Magellanic Cloud supernova remnant N 132D using observations from the Australia Telescope Compact Array (ATCA) and MeerKAT. The radio morphology shows a clear spatial correlation with the X-ray emission in the central and left regions of the remnant, as well as in the right portion of the shell, indicating a close connection between the thermal and non-thermal plasma components. Polarisation measurements reveal predominantly radial magnetic fields, with mean fractional polarisations of 1.2 per cent, 3.0 per cent, and 4.0 per cent at 2100, 5500, and 9000 MHz, respectively. There is also a complex structure in the Faraday Depth spectrum, showing a double-peaked profile that indicates regions with differing magnetisation properties or varying magnetic field geometry. The rotation measure derived from ATCA data has an average value of ~2 rad m^-2, with a maximum of ~338 rad m^-2. We estimate a constant partition magnetic field of ~90 microG and a minimum energy of 3 x 10^50 erg, which is in a constant partition between the energy density of electrons and the energy density of the magnetic field. The integrated radio spectrum follows a power law with a spectral index of -0.74 +- 0.01. These results provide new constraints on the magnetic field structure and energetic properties of N 132D and offer insight into particle acceleration and shock evolution in young supernova remnants.
papers.title_cn: 对最亮的大麦哲伦云超新星遗迹之一 N 132D 的射电连续谱研究
papers.abs_cn: 我们利用澳大利亚望远镜致密阵列（ATCA）和 MeerKAT 的观测，对大麦哲伦云超新星遗迹 N 132D 进行了新的射电连续谱研究。射电形态显示，在遗迹的中心和左侧区域以及壳层的右侧部分，与 X 射线辐射存在明显的空间相关性，表明热等离子体和非热等离子体成分之间存在密切联系。偏振测量显示磁场以径向为主，在 2100、5500 和 9000 MHz 处的平均偏振度分别为 1.2%、3.0% 和 4.0%。法拉第深度谱中还呈现出复杂结构，表现为双峰轮廓，表明存在磁化性质不同或磁场几何结构不同的区域。由 ATCA 数据得到的旋转测度平均值为 ~2 rad m^-2，最大值为 ~338 rad m^-2。我们估算出恒定分配磁场约为 ~90 microG，最小能量为 3 x 10^50 erg，这对应于电子能量密度与磁场能量密度之间的恒定分配。积分射电谱遵循幂律，谱指数为 -0.74 +- 0.01。这些结果为 N 132D 的磁场结构和能量性质提供了新的限制，并为年轻超新星遗迹中的粒子加速和激波演化提供了见解。

papers.title: Achieving room temperature plasticity in TiO2 ceramics by flash processing
papers.abstract: Ceramics are indispensable materials for modern engineering and high-technology applications. However, the intrinsic brittleness at room temperature can cause catastrophic failure and severely limit their widespread applications. Here, we report a flash processing (FP) method based on the coupling of electric and thermal fields to significantly improve the room-temperature plasticity of TiO2 ceramics with a large plastic compressive strain of 15.4% during micropillar compression. This large room-temperature plasticity is attributed to the proliferation of stacking faults and twin boundaries during the loading process, which may be assisted by the high concentration of oxygen vacancies introduced by the FP method. Our findings suggest that FP can be a simple and effective method for achieving improved room-temperature plasticity of ceramic materials through defect engineering.
papers.title_cn: 通过闪烧处理实现TiO2陶瓷的室温塑性
papers.abs_cn: 陶瓷是现代工程和高技术应用中不可或缺的材料。然而，室温下的固有脆性可能导致灾难性失效，并严重限制其广泛应用。在此，我们报道了一种基于电场和热场耦合的闪烧处理（FP）方法，可显著提高TiO2陶瓷的室温塑性，在微柱压缩过程中实现了15.4%的大塑性压缩应变。这种大的室温塑性归因于加载过程中层错和孪晶界的增殖，这可能得到了FP方法引入的高浓度氧空位的辅助。我们的发现表明，FP可以是一种简单有效的方法，通过缺陷工程实现陶瓷材料室温塑性的改善。

papers.title: Selected open-charm decays of the narrow \(P_c\) states: Quark-interchange predictions and pion-exchange sensitivity
papers.abstract: The proximity of the narrow $P_c(4312)$, $P_c(4440)$, and $P_c(4457)$ structures to the $Σ_c\bar D^{(*)}$ thresholds motivates their interpretation as hadronic molecules. We treat the $P_c(4312)$ as an $S$-wave $Σ_c\bar D$ state with $J^P=1/2^-$ and examine both $J^P=1/2^-$ and $3/2^-$ $Σ_c\bar D^*$ assignments for each heavier peak. The selected $S$-wave open-charm transitions to $Λ_c\bar D^{(*)}$ are calculated at Born order in the quark-interchange model, including the prior and post rearrangement diagrams and their color, flavor, spin, and spatial matrix elements. Across the input variations considered, the quark-interchange widths robustly favor $Λ_c\bar D^*$ over $Λ_c\bar D$ for every $J^P=1/2^-$ assignment. At either heavier peak mass, the $Λ_c\bar D^*$ width for $J^P=3/2^-$ is suppressed by approximately one order of magnitude relative to $J^P=1/2^-$, providing a potential decay-based discriminator of the spin assignments. The large channel hierarchies arise from spatial overlaps and interference between spin-independent and hyperfine contributions and are not universal heavy-quark-spin-symmetry ratios. We also explore a retarded one-pion-exchange transition at first Born order. It affects $P_c(4312)\toΛ_c\bar D^*$ most strongly, while the coherent widths remain sensitive to the cutoff, energy-transfer prescription, short-distance subtraction, and unresolved relative matching sign. The quark-interchange hierarchies are therefore the central predictions, whereas the pion-exchange results quantify matching sensitivity. Measurements of the $Λ_c\bar D^*$ modes can directly test these patterns.
papers.title_cn: 窄 P_c 态的部分开粲衰变：夸克交换预言与π交换敏感性
papers.abs_cn: 窄 P_c(4312)、P_c(4440) 和 P_c(4457) 结构与 Σ_c\bar D^{(*)} 阈值的接近促使人们将其解释为强子分子态。我们将 P_c(4312) 视为 J^P=1/2^- 的 S 波 Σ_c\bar D 态，并对每个较重的峰考察 J^P=1/2^- 和 3/2^- 的 Σ_c\bar D^* 指派。所选 S 波开粲跃迁到 Λ_c\bar D^{(*)} 在夸克交换模型中按 Born 阶计算，包括 prior 和 post 重排图及其色、味、自旋和空间矩阵元。在所考虑的输入变化范围内，夸克交换宽度对所有 J^P=1/2^- 指派都稳健地偏好 Λ_c\bar D^* 而非 Λ_c\bar D。在任一较重峰质量处，J^P=3/2^- 的 Λ_c\bar D^* 宽度相对于 J^P=1/2^- 被压低约一个数量级，为自旋指派提供了潜在的基于衰变的判别手段。大的通道层级来源于空间重叠以及自旋无关贡献与超精细贡献之间的干涉，并非普适的重夸克自旋对称性比值。我们还探讨了第一 Born 阶的推迟单π交换跃迁。它对 P_c(4312)->Λ_c\bar D^* 影响最强，而相干宽度仍对截断、能量转移方案、短距离减除以及未解决的相对匹配符号敏感。因此，夸克交换层级是核心预言，而π交换结果量化了匹配敏感性。对 Λ_c\bar D^* 模式的测量可以直接检验这些模式。

papers.title: Injectivity of specialization maps in critical cohomology
papers.abstract: Specialization maps are natural maps from equivariant vanishing cycle cohomology to the equivariant cohomology of the ambient space. We study their injectivity problem for moduli stacks of representations of quivers with potentials, including those associated with generalized conifolds and finite subgroups of $SO(3,\mathbb{C})$.
papers.title_cn: 临界上同调中特殊化映射的单射性
papers.abs_cn: 特殊化映射是从等变消没圈上同调到环境空间的等变上同调的自然映射。我们研究了带势箭图表示模栈的单射性问题，包括与广义锥形流形和 $SO(3,\mathbb{C})$ 的有限子群相关的模栈。

papers.title: Multipolar fluctuations in localized $4f^2$-electron systems from dynamical mean-field theory: application to $\mathrm{PrCdNi}_4$
papers.abstract: Multipolar-fluctuation analysis based on density functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory is extended from $4f^1$- to $4f^2$-electron systems. Two methodological developments are presented. First, many-particle states are constructed within the $j$-$j$ coupling scheme in the $j=5/2$ subspace, so as to reproduce the crystalline-electric-field splitting of the $4f^2$ Hund's-rule ground-state multiplet. Second, multipolar susceptibilities and interactions between $4f^2$ multiplets are derived through a mapping from single-particle to many-particle bases. We apply this framework to PrCdNi$_4$, which has a non-Kramers $Γ_3$ doublet ground state, and propose a $(3z^2-r^2)$-type antiferroquadrupolar order at $\boldsymbol{q}=(2π,π,0)$ driven by the competition between nearest- and fourth-nearest-neighbor interactions. The formalism developed here is applicable to general $4f^n$-electron systems.
papers.title_cn: 局域 $4f^2$ 电子系统中基于动力学平均场理论的多极涨落：应用于 $\mathrm{PrCdNi}_4$
papers.abs_cn: 基于密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论的多极涨落分析从 $4f^1$ 电子系统推广到 $4f^2$ 电子系统。本文提出两项方法学进展。第一，在 $j=5/2$ 子空间内采用 $j$-$j$ 耦合方案构建多粒子态，以重现 $4f^2$ Hund 规则基态多重态的晶体电场劈裂。第二，通过从单粒子基到多粒子基的映射，导出多极磁化率以及 $4f^2$ 多重态之间的相互作用。我们将该框架应用于具有非 Kramers $Γ_3$ 二重态基态的 PrCdNi$_4$，并提出在 $\boldsymbol{q}=(2π,π,0)$ 处由最近邻与第四近邻相互作用之间的竞争所驱动的 $(3z^2-r^2)$ 型反铁四极序。本文发展的形式体系适用于一般的 $4f^n$ 电子系统。

papers.title: Demonstration of ultrafast coherent sub-picosecond magnon pulses
papers.abstract: Ultrafast magnonics explores routes towards energy-efficient information processing by replacing electrons with pulses of terahertz magnons. The critical, but so far elusive, requirement on the magnon pulses is the combination of high-speed and a long-range propagation while maintaining a well-defined narrow waveform of the pulses. Here, we demonstrate the launching of 0.4-picosecond magnon pulses in the altermagnetic insulator $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) using broadband terahertz spin-orbit torques by an adjacent platinum layer. Phase-resolved terahertz transmission reveals that these sub-picosecond pulses travel ballistically, coherently and non-dispersively at a constant velocity of 23 nm/ps, transport angular momentum and retain their temporal waveform shape over 160 nm, with an inferred relaxation length in hundreds of nanometers or more. Beyond establishing $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ as an optimal platform for ultrafast magnonics, our technique introduces a high-resolution, tabletop method to directly extract dispersion relations up to high wavevectors, and explore ultrafast magnon dynamics in altermagnets and other magnetic materials with teraherz-range dynamics.
papers.title_cn: 超快相干亚皮秒磁振子脉冲的演示
papers.abs_cn: 超快磁振子学探索了通过用太赫兹磁振子脉冲替代电子来实现节能信息处理的途径。对磁振子脉冲的关键但迄今难以实现的要求是兼具高速和长距离传播，同时保持脉冲具有明确且狭窄的波形。在此，我们展示了在交错磁绝缘体 alpha-Fe2O3（赤铁矿）中，利用相邻铂层产生的宽带太赫兹自旋轨道矩发射出 0.4 皮秒磁振子脉冲。相位分辨太赫兹透射表明，这些亚皮秒脉冲以 23 nm/ps 的恒定速度弹道式、相干且非色散地传播，输运角动量，并在 160 nm 的距离内保持其时间波形形状，推断出的弛豫长度为数百纳米或更长。除了确立 alpha-Fe2O3 作为超快磁振子学的最佳平台之外，我们的技术还引入了一种高分辨率、桌面式的方法，可直接提取高达高波矢的色散关系，并探索交错磁体和其他具有太赫兹范围动力学的磁性材料中的超快磁振子动力学。
